locations.name: Ainsel River

infobox.sub-regions: Ainsel River Main; Lake of Rot

locations.summary: Ainsel River is an underground region in Elden Ring.
overview: One of the two great rivers that flow beneath the Lands Between. Ainsel is said to be the grave of civilisations that flourished before the Erdtree. The eastern side of Ainsel is dominated by the Uhl Palace Ruins, characterised by their mausoleums and statues, and inhabited by the Claymen who served as priests of the ancient dynasty.

Nokstella, one of the Eternal Cities, can be found in the western portion of the subterranean space, inhabited by the Nox who were banished underground by the Greater Will long ago. Deeper still is the Lake of Rot, a putrid underground swamp littered with ancient ruins, where the essence of an Outer God was sealed. At the deepest point is the lair of Astel, a malformed star who once assailed an Eternal City and took away its sky. Beyond Astel is a lift which leads to the Moonlight Altar, provided the Dark Moon Ring has been found.

Ainsel can be accessed via the Ainsel River Well in eastern Liurnia of the Lakes. The Ainsel River Main, which encompasses Nokstella, can be accessed via a sending gate in Renna's Rise, after Ranni the Witch gets her hands on the Fingerslayer Blade.
notes: The name Ainsel, meaning "Own Self" in the Scots language, is the name of a fairy from Scottish and Gaelic folklore. The name Siofra has similar origins.

→ When Ainsel snuck into a cabin and found a boy, she asked his name and he answered "My Ainsel". And so, when the two were playing with fire and a cinder hit Ainsel's foot, she yelled in pain. The fairy mother asked Ainsel who had done such a thing, and she responded "It was My Ainsel!" The fair mother chastised her, saying "what's all the noise about? There's nyen [no one] to blame."

locations.name: Altus Plateau
locations.summary: Altus Plateau is a region in Elden Ring.
overview: The Altus Plateau is a northwestern region of the Lands Between. It is a region of great significance, for it is here that the Erdtree can be found, as well as Leyndell, the royal capital of Queen Marika. Altus borders Liurnia of the Lakes to the south, and the Forbidden Lands which lead to the Mountaintops of the Giants to the east. Due to its high elevation, Altus is connected to its neighbouring regions primarily through two lifts; the Grand Lift of Dectus to the south and the Grand Lift of Rold to the east. There is another, more dangerous path to Liurnia that goes through the mountains separating the two regions.

Altus is a lush and verdant land, once over-flowing with the bounty of the Erdtree itself. Most of the vegetation that grows in Altus is tinged with the gold of the Erdtree, and flowers that grow on the plateau are prized reagents by Perfumers. The people of the plateau believed that those born at the foot of the Erdtree, like themselves, were blessed. While still beautiful, the land is marred by scars from the Shattering, left over from the many battles waged here. The land is dotted by ruined battlefields and soldier's camps.

The western parts of Altus are mountainous and dominated by the volcanic Mt. Gelmir. At the top of the mountain lies the Volcano Manor, home to the demigod Praetor Rykard. At the foot of the mountain lies bubbling geysers as well as a village of Demihumans.

In the north of Altus, through a deep canyon, lies the Shaded Castle, ancient manor of the Marais family who served as both executioners and castellans of the Shaded Castle for generations. The castle lies in disrepair, haunted by Wraith-Callers and Revenants, and with most of its courtyard sinking into a poison swamp.

The eastern parts of Altus are dominated by Leyndell, Queen Marika's royal capital, built at the foot of the Erdtree. Two primary paths lead into the capital grounds; one from the southwest and one from the northwest. The southwestern path is the main road, a well-maintained and well-guarded highway gloriously decorated with statues of Queen Marika's soldiers. The capital grounds are defended by double ramparts. Within the outer wall, to the northeast, lies a Minor Erdtree. Just outside the outer wall, on an outcropping north of the southwestern highway, lies the Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave, final resting place of a hero who fought against the Giants.

The inner wall of the capital is surrounded by a moat, which appears to have mostly dried out, as its waters are now shallow. Within the inner walls, the Royal Capital is bounded by a lake, which serves as yet another layer of protection. The capital is ruled by the Demigod Morgott, known also as the Veiled Monarch.
sites_of_grace: Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate

locations.name: Caelid
locations.summary: Caelid is a region in Elden Ring.
overview: A wasteland on the southeastern tip of the Lands Between, plagued by Scarlet Rot and inhabited by all manner of malformed creatures. Caelid borders Limgrave to its west. It was the site of the battle between General Radahn and Malenia, Blade of Miquella, during which the first flower of Aeonia bloomed and covered the region in Scarlet Rot. Radahn's army, the Redmanes, continues to combat the rot using fire.

Caelid is characterized by its blood-red skies, rocks, and vegetation. To its southeast lies the Wailing Dunes, a vast expanse of red sand where General Radahn wanders in his madness. The heart of Caelid is home to the rot-filled Swamp of Aeonia, covered in remains from the Battle of Aeonia. Sellia, Town of Sorcery sits on the eastern shore of the Swamp of Aeonia, now inhabited only by specters. The northern region of Caelid is called Dragonbarrow, home to Elder Dragon Greyoll and her offspring. Like the Weeping Peninsula, Dragonbarrow hosts an unceasing rainstorm.

While Dragonbarrow is not under control of the Redmanes, Radahn's forces operate in southern Caelid. Redmane Castle is the stronghold of the Redmanes, home to the Radahn Festival and currently overseen by Castellan Jerren.
notes: The northeastern peninsula of Caelid has connections to Crumbling Farum Azula; the peninsula is accessed via the Farum Greatbridge, and its most prominent structure is the Bestial Sanctum, home to Gurranq, Beast Clergyman.
In Welsh, "Cae llid" roughly translates to "inflamed field", referencing the region's festering condition.

locations.name: Deeproot Depths
locations.summary: Deeproot Depths is an underground region in Elden Ring.
overview: An enormous cavern at the roots of the Erdtree, which is the source of the Ainsel and Siofra rivers. The network of roots that spread throughout the Lands Between also begins here.

A nameless Eternal City lies in ruins here, with many of its buildings sinking into a mire of pale liquid. In the north-western area, a Wandering Mausoleum prowls, surrounded by Mausoleum Soldiers and Knights. To the far west, Siluria, one of the two leaders of the Crucible Knights, awaits at the stump of a dead tree.

After Godwyn the Golden was killed on the Night of Black Knives, his body was buried in the Erdtree's roots. His malformed body, corrupted by Death, can be found to the north of the cavern. It is here that Fia resides after fleeing Roundtable Hold.

locations.name: Limgrave
locations.summary: Limgrave is a region in the Lands Between.
overview: A temperate land of green plains and golden trees, with windswept hills to the north and a dense, mist-shrouded woodland to the east. Limgrave is the first open area encountered by the player after emerging from the Stranded Graveyard, located in the southwest of the Lands Between. It borders Liurnia to its northwest and Caelid to its northeast. In the south of Limgrave lies the Weeping Peninsula, an isolated region known for its unceasing rain.

Godrick the Grafted presides over Limgrave from Stormveil Castle, located in the region's northwest at the top of Stormhill. Limgrave lies at the lowest elevation of all the overworld regions in the Lands Between, with accessible beaches on its western, southern, and eastern coasts. The center of Limgrave is home to Lake Agheel, a name it shares with its resident dragon. The lake is the source of Murkwater River, which flows northward through Highroad Cave and empties into the bay in the middle of the Lands Between.

Other notable locations in Limgrave include the Limgrave Colosseum, two Minor Erdtrees, Fort Haight, Castle Morne, and numerous churches, ruined towns, caves, catacombs, tunnels, evergaols, and shacks.
sub_regions: Stranded Graveyard, a cavern containing the Fringefolk Hero's Grave; this is where the journey of the Tarnished begins.
Stormhill, a foggy and windy area at the foot of Stormveil Castle.
Weeping Peninsula, the southernmost tip of the Lands Between with unending rainfall.
notes: Turtle necks are a valued nutritional ingredient in Limgrave.

locations.name: Liurnia of the Lakes
locations.summary: Liurnia of the Lakes is a region in the Lands Between.
overview: The westernmost region of the Lands Between. Characterized by its boggy woodlands, sheer cliffs, and pervasive mists, much of the region is sinking into the Liurnia Lake.

On the eastern side of the region, the Liurnia Highway runs north to south, connecting the land to the Altus Plateau and Limgrave. The western coast is closely associated with the royal family of Caria, as it is the location of their stronghold in Caria Manor. The Academy of Raya Lucaria rises above the lake in the center of Liurnia at a junction between two highroads, with the Academy Gate Town sprawling around its base as the buildings slowly sink into the waters.

Liurnia is mostly under the control of Raya Lucaria and its Knights of the Cuckoo. The Carians also maintain a presence at their manor and the Carian Study Hall. The Lunar Queen Rennala was master of the academy, but she is now locked in its grand library.

locations.name: Mountaintops of the Giants

infobox.sub-regions: Forbidden Lands; Flame Peak; Consecrated Snowfield

locations.summary: Mountaintops of the Giants is a region in Elden Ring.
overview: The northern Mountaintops were once the home of the Fire Giants, after they claimed them from the ice dragons. At the birth of the Erdtree, the forces of Queen Marika the Eternal and Godfrey, First Elden Lord marched up the mountain and put the Giants to the sword. With the Giants defeated, the Flame of Ruin was confined within the Giants' Forge atop the mount, and the Age of the Erdtree began.

The Fire Monks, who were left behind to watch over the Flame of Ruin, can be found patrolling the region. They are often accompanied by the Guilty: thorn sorcerers who were banished to the north. Their fortress, the Guardians' Garrison, sits on the eastern side of the mountain.

The Zamor Ruins in the south-west are the home of an ancient clan of Zamor Warriors. They were ancient enemies of the Fire Giants, and are regarded as heroes due to their actions in the War Against the Giants.

The Mountaintops were also home to the astrologers, neighbours of the Giants and predecessors to the modern Glintstone Sorcerers. The ruins of their civilisation can be found in the central Mountaintops.

The northernmost section of the Mountaintops is dominated by Castle Sol, where the site of an eclipse once inspired dreadful awe. Half of a medallion that will grant access to Miquella's Haligtree can be found here, protected by Commander Niall.

The medallion can be used at the Grand Lift of Rold to gain access to the Consecrated Snowfield, which sprawls to the west of the Mountaintops. The Albinaurics, and others who revere Miquella, seek this sacred land in the hopes of earning the Empyrean's favour. Ordina, Liturgical Town is the final stop on the way to the Haligtree, and is home to the spirits of several Albinauric women.
sites_of_grace: Divine Tower of East Altus: Gate
field_bosses: Death Rite Bird (Mountaintops of the Giants)

locations.name: Siofra River

infobox.location: Underground area beneath Mistwood and Caelid
infobox.sub-regions: Nokron, Eternal City; Mohgwyn Palace; Night's Sacred Ground

locations.summary: Siofra River is an underground region in Elden Ring.
overview: One of the two great rivers that flow beneath the Lands Between. Siofra is said to be the grave of civilisations that flourished before the Erdtree, and evidence of this can be found in the many ancient structures that litter the vast, subterranean space. The towering remains of an ancient dynasty are prominent throughout the area, inhabited by the Claymen who once served as the dynasty's priests.

The lower portion of Siofra River can be accessed via the Siofra River Well in Limgrave's Mistwood. This wooded area is home to spectral Ancestral Followers, who live alongside a diverse assortment of wildlife. The remains of a great, horned beast can be found in the Hallowhorn Grounds. Interacting with the remains after lightning the flames scattered throughout the area will facilitate an encounter with an Ancestor Spirit. This area also connects to Caelid via the Deep Siofra Well.

Towering over the woodland is Nokron, one of the Eternal Cities inhabited by the Nox. Nokron is initially inaccessible, however a route is opened when a star falls upon Limgrave, following the defeat of Starscourge Radahn. The Fingerslayer Blade, a treasure of Nokron said to be able to harm the Greater Will and its vassal Fingers, is found within Night's Sacred Ground, beneath a chair-crypt that holds a vast corpse. This upper region also houses another Hallowhorn Grounds, from which the Regal Ancestor Spirit can be encountered. Nearby, the aqueduct hides a coffin which can be used to access Deeproot Depths, guarded by a pair of Valiant Gargoyles.

To the east, on a separate island within the vast cavern, are the ruins of an ancient palace. It is here that Mohg, Lord of Blood has established the seat of his coming Mohgwyn Dynasty, and all the nightmares it may bring.
notes: The name Síofra is pronounced "SHEE-fra". It is a girl's name in the Irish Gaelic language, meaning "sprite, fairy, elf, changeling". The síobhraí were believed to be fairies that had been left in place of a human (typically a child) stolen by other fairies. The name Ainsel has similar origins.
→ The word Síofra could also refer to "weakling" in some contexts.

locations.name: Crumbling Farum Azula
locations.region: Accessed via Mountaintops of the Giants

infobox.region: Accessed via Mountaintops of the Giants
infobox.bosses: Godskin Duo; Dragonlord Placidusax; Maliketh, the Black Blade

locations.summary: Crumbling Farum Azula is a region and legacy dungeon in Elden Ring accessed from the Mountaintops of the Giants after burning the Erdtree.
overview: A giant ruined temple city in the sky, located above the sea to the east of the Lands Between. Once a royal city and the seat of the Dragonlord Placidusax, Farum Azula has been crumbling since time immemorial. Now, it is a mausoleum, guarded by chosen Beastmen who wield weapons clad in lightning. The storm beyond time rages in the center of the crumbling city, and at its heart is the Dragonlord's seat, where he awaits the return of his god.

As well as Beastmen, Farum Azula is home to a number of Ancient Dragons who roost on the floating fragments of the city. There is a small population of Wormfaces dwelling in one of the lower levels of the city. It appears that Deathroot has spread throughout parts of the city as well. The great rotundum at the center of Farum Azula is the dwelling place of Maliketh, the Black Blade, the protector of the Rune of Death.
It is here that the Tarnished finds themselves after they set the Erdtree aflame, and where they finally unbind the Rune of Death, releasing it upon the Lands Between.

Farum Azula can only be accessed in full after setting the Erdtree aflame at the Forge of the Giants. After doing so, the Tarnished will wake up on a bridge leading to the city. The area can also be previewed by taking one of the Sending Gates (labeled "Crumbling Lands") at the Four Belfries in Liurnia. This Sending Gate leads to an isolated floating fragment of stone from which the rest of Farum Azula can be seen but not accessed.
The only area in the Lands Between from which Farum Azula is visible is the Isolated Divine Tower.
notes: This location was referred to as "Doomed Farum Azula" in Game Version 1.00.

locations.name: Nokstella, Eternal City
locations.summary: Nokstella, Eternal City is a location in the Ainsel River Main in Elden Ring.
overview: One of the Eternal Cities inhabited by the Nox, who were banished underground after evoking the ire of the Greater Will. Nokstella is located in the Ainsel River Main, on the west side of the underground river Ainsel, and can only be accessed by using the sending gate in Renna's Rise and following the path through the northern Uhl Palace Ruins.
The lost black moon of Nokstella was once the guide to countless stars, and a talisman representing it is regarded as a treasure of the city.

locations.name: Leyndell, Ashen Capital

infobox.bosses: Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing; Godfrey, First Elden Lord

locations.summary:
For the version of this area visited earlier in the game, see Leyndell, Royal Capital.

Leyndell, Ashen Capital is a legacy dungeon located in Altus Plateau. It is an altered form of Leyndell, Royal Capital which can be accessed after defeating Maliketh, the Black Blade.
overview: With the defeat of Maliketh, the Black Blade, the Rune of Death is unbound, and the Flame of Ruin burns away the impenetrable thorns blocking the entrance to the Erdtree. The city of Leyndell is blanketed in thick ash, burying all but the tallest buildings. The Tarnished returns to the city after releasing the Rune of Death, finally able to approach the Erdtree and gain entry.
The Eastern Capital Ramparts remains accessible, serving as the remaining access point that links the Ashen Capital with the rest of the world. The Capital Outskirts and beyond remain unchanged.
While the Ashen Capital replaces the Royal Capital and most of its landmarks are rendered inaccessible, a few key areas can be reached via alternate routes:

It is still possible to access the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds from this version of Leyndell. A manhole cover in the center of the region that was previously closed is now open, allowing for one to drop down into the sewers below. The Crimson Amber Medallion +2 is also located on a beam that is only accessible here.

The Divine Bridge Site of Grace that leads to the waygate to the Isolated Divine Tower can no longer be accessed from the Fortified Manor. The only way to get there now is to use the teleporter trap atop the Tower of Return.

While the gate that leads from the capital center to the Mountaintops of the Giants is blocked shut, you can travel backwards along that pathway. The lake that once was inaccessible is now filled with ash and debris, and amidst the Ulcerated Tree Spirits that patrol the lake is Erdtree's Favor +2.
notable_loot: All-Knowing Set (dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing)
Scepter of the All-Knowing (dropped by Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing)
Remembrance of Hoarah Loux (dropped by Godfrey, First Elden Lord)

locations.name: Leyndell, Royal Capital

infobox.bosses:
Godfrey, First Elden Lord;
Morgott, the Omen King

locations.summary: Leyndell, Royal Capital is a legacy dungeon and region on the Altus Plateau.
overview: The golden city at the foot of the Erdtree. Leyndell is the capital of the empire of the Golden Order. It is enclosed by double ramparts, with the city proper contained within the inner wall. To this day, the inner wall has never been breached. The current lord of Leyndell is Morgott, the Veiled Monarch, a Demigod of the Golden Lineage who took it upon himself to become the Erdtree's protector despite being born a graceless Omen.
Despite the decline of the Lands Between since the Shattering, Leyndell remains heavily fortified and armed to the teeth with knights, soldiers, and siege equipment.
The Fortified Manor, in the south-western portion of the city, is a perfect likeness of the Roundtable Hold. Unlike the Hold, where Tarnished champions gather, the Manor sits abandoned.

Far below the city is the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, a network of sewers and waterways inhabited by Omens. The Leyndell Catacombs also branch off from this underground realm. Even further below lies the Cathedral of the Forsaken, where a tribe of nomadic merchants were entombed so as to bury the maddening disease that followed them. In their underground prison they chanted a curse of despair, summoning the Flame of Frenzy.
The Elden Throne sits beneath the Erdtree in the southeastern area of the city. It is here that Morgott stands guard, determined to protect the Erdtree from would-be champions.
notable_loot: Omensmirk Mask (Dropped by an Omenkiller outside the Lower Capital Church)
Raging Wolf Set (Dropped by Vargram the Raging Wolf)

locations.name: Redmane Castle
locations.summary: Redmane Castle is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A fortress on an island to the south of Caelid, connected to the mainland by a heavily fortified greatbridge. The castle is the stronghold of General Radahn's army, beaten yet unbowed after their defeat at the hands of Malenia and her Cleanrot Knights.

Redmane Castle is also the site of the Radahn Festival; a contest in which great champions attempt to defeat the Rot-maddened Radahn and claim his Great Rune. This event is initiated either by activating a Site of Grace in Altus Plateau or by progressing Ranni the Witch's questline.

During the Radahn Festival, all of the enemies in the castle (except for the two Elden Lions) will disappear, and the boss (if not defeated already) will not show up in the plaza. Once Starscourge Radahn has been defeated, the enemies will return and the boss can be fought if they have not already.
notable_loot: Ruins Greatsword (dropped by Misbegotten Warrior & Crucible Knight)

locations.name: Forge of the Giants
locations.summary: Forge of the Giants is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: Long ago, Queen Marika the Eternal ordered Godfrey and his warriors to go to war against the Giants. When the war ended, and the Fire Giants were defeated, the flame of ruin was confined within the cauldron-shaped forge at the easternmost peak of the Mountaintops of the Giants, with a sole Fire Giant left behind as its guardian.

It is from here that the flame of ruin is unleashed, either by Melina or by the Tarnished, in order to burn the Erdtree. After doing so, the Tarnished is transported to Crumbling Farum Azula, where the Rune of Death is hidden.

locations.name: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds
locations.summary: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: An intricate system of sewers and dungeons that spreads out below Leyndell, Royal Capital. It is crawling with all kinds of shunned creatures, most notably the Omen, who are imprisoned there unbeknownst to anyone. The layout is disorienting due to the multitude of tunnels, waterways, and chambers. Deep within the dungeon is a cathedral, where an encounter with Mohg, the Omen occurs. The altar at the back of the cathedral is illusory, and hides a passage which can only be unsealed by killing Morgott, the Omen King in the city above. The passage leads to a catacomb which plunges deep into the earth. It is here that a nomadic tribe was once entombed so as to bury a maddening disease that followed them, and where, in their despair, they summoned the flame of frenzy. The Three Fingers can be met behind a door at the lowest level of the catacomb, provided one removes all of their equipment first.
The entrance to the Leyndell Catacombs can be found within the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. It is in the room with the Crayfish.
notable_loot: Bloodflame Talons (dropped by Mohg, the Omen)

locations.name: Castle Morne
locations.summary: Castle Morne is a dungeon in the Weeping Peninsula.
overview: A large, heavily fortified castle that rises from the southern tip of the Weeping Peninsula. The castle was overseen by Castellan Edgar at the appointment of Godrick the Grafted. However, it has since been commandeered by its Misbegotten servants, who now control much of the castle. Castellan Edgar is one of the last holdouts, as nearby soldiers brawl with the Misbegotten.
In antiquity, this castle was the site of a battle between Godfrey, First Elden Lord and a lone hero, which is commemorated by a Sword Monument nearby.
notable_loot: Grafted Blade Greatsword (obtained from Leonine Misbegotten)

locations.name: Stormveil Castle

infobox.bosses:
Margit, the Fell Omen
Godrick the Grafted

locations.summary: Stormveil Castle is a legacy dungeon located in Limgrave.
overview: Stormveil Castle perches atop a cliff overlooking Limgrave. Currently, it is the stronghold of the Demigod Godrick the Grafted, but long ago it was ruled over by an old king, back when the true storm raged. The castle is heavily guarded and patrolled by Banished Knights, Exile Soldiers, and warhawks with blades grafted to their talons. The exterior of the castle is mottled with craters lined with thorns, which have also spread to the soldiers within. It is said that the source may be hidden deep within the castle.
notable_loot: Spectral Steed Regalia: Tree Sentinel Tarnished Pack

locations.name: Academy of Raya Lucaria

infobox.bosses: Red Wolf of Radagon; Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

locations.summary: Academy of Raya Lucaria is a legacy dungeon located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
overview: The Academy of Raya Lucaria sits in the middle of the great lake of Liurnia, and is the place of study for Glintstone Sorcerers. Long ago, Rennala charmed the Academy with her lunar magic. She became the Academy's master and established the house of Caria as royalty. However, when Rennala's husband Radagon left her to become the second Elden Lord, Rennala's heart went along with him. Those at the Academy then realised that Rennala was no champion, and she was confined to the great library. She still clutches the amber egg given to her by Radagon, which contains the Great Rune of the Unborn.

The Academy offers multiple fields of study, known as Conspectuses. Scholars of note are permitted to don Glintstone Crowns modelled after notable sorcerers in their chosen fields of study. Azur and Lusat, regarded as founding glintstone sorcerers, founded the Karolos and Olivinus Conspectuses, respectively. Most of the sorcerers found within wear Glintstone Crowns that denote their area of study, and hint at the types of sorceries they may wield.

The Academy declared that it would not take part in The Shattering, and repelling seals were cast upon its doors, blocking outside access to anyone not in possession of a Academy Glintstone Key. Such a key may be found on an island west of the Academy, guarded by Glintstone Dragon Smarag.
bosses: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon
npcs: Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon

locations.name: Grand Lift of Dectus

infobox.region: Liurnia of the Lakes; Altus Plateau

locations.summary: Grand Lift of Dectus is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A vast lift which connects Liurnia to Altus Plateau. Four giant statues loom over the lift, which is built into the plateau's sheer cliffs. The lift can only be activated by uniting the Dectus Medallion (Left), found in Fort Haight, and the Dectus Medallion (Right), found in Fort Faroth.

locations.name: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree
locations.summary: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree is sub-region and dungeon in Miquella's Haligtree.
overview: A jaded golden city to the north of the Lands Between.

It is an optional endgame area that can only be reached by descending from Miquella's Haligtree, past Loretta, Knight of the Haligtree. The boss at the end of this area, deep within the city, is Malenia, Blade of Miquella.

The footsoldiers of Elphael are devastated by the bitter revelation that Miquella has been stolen away, and they roam the city awaiting his return. The knights of the Haligtree also reside in Elphael; though their lord is absent, they are formidable nonetheless, and time has yet to dull their unalloyed gold.

The city of Elphael is built in tiers around the northeastern side of the Haligtree. It's possible that the city does indeed serve as a brace for the tree, as indicated in its name. The depths of the city lead to the inside of the Haligtree, where Malenia awaits her brother's return; this inner area is festering with the Scarlet Rot, as is the lower tier of Elphael itself.

locations.name: Miquella's Haligtree
locations.summary: Miquella's Haligtree (ミケラの聖樹, Mikera no Seiju) is a region and legacy dungeon to the north of the Lands Between.
overview: A holy tree created by Miquella off the northern coast of the Consecrated Snowfield.

Miquella's Haligtree is a vast, misshapen tree in the far north of the Lands Between. Miquella's vision for the Haligtree was never fully realized, and even in their beauty, the town and city brace are teeming with danger.

The Haligtree consists of two sections: the upper area is home to Haligtree Town in the canopy of the tree, and the lower area houses Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree, an immense fortress. While Haligtree Town is teeming with Misbegotten, Elphael is inhabited largely by soldiers and knights who serve Miquella and Malenia.
notes: "Hālig" in Old English meant "holy" and "sacred", so the name translates to "holy-tree".

locations.name: Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum
locations.summary: Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum is a location on the Siofra River in Elden Ring.
overview: A towering, ancient temple built into a rocky formation on the west side of Mohgwyn Palace. The mausoleum, once part of the ancient dynasty, is now the grave of the ancient civilization and the stronghold of Mohg, Lord of Blood and his followers. It is the seat of the Lord of Blood's new Mohgwyn Dynasty.

The mausoleum can be accessed by traversing the rest of the Mohgwyn Palace sub-region, which is reached via a sending gate on the western edge of the Consecrated Snowfield. Alternately, using the Pureblood Knight's Medal granted by White Mask Varré will teleport the user straight to the mausoleum's entrance.
At the top of the structure is a large, open courtyard, in which sits the cocoon of Miquella the Empyrean. Mohg slumbers there until disturbed, seeking a response from the comatose divinity.
notable_loot: Mohg's Great Rune (dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood)
Remembrance of the Blood Lord (dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood)

locations.name: Castle Sol
locations.summary: Castle Sol is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A castle in the northern Mountaintops of the Giants. The master of Castle Sol was once given half of a medallion that would allow him to visit Miquella's Haligtree. The castle was the site of an attempt to trigger an eclipse, in order to restore the soul of Miquella's comrade, however the sun was not swallowed and the master of the castle lost hope of ever seeing the Haligtree. Commander Niall, a veteran of Castle Sol, remained in the castle, commanding the spirits of his army of no nation to protect his long-passed master.

locations.name: Volcano Manor

infobox.bosses: Godskin Noble; Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy

locations.summary: Volcano Manor is a legacy dungeon located on Mt. Gelmir.
overview: The Volcano Manor is home to the recusants of Praetor Rykard, fierce warriors who wage war against the Erdtree and the Roundtable. The recusants are led by Rykard's consort, Lady Tanith. Powerful Tarnished are extended invitations to join the Volcano Manor and are given contracts to hunt other Tarnished in service of the Roundtable. Tarnished who prove themselves are offered an audience with Praetor Rykard himself, which will inevitably end with the serpentine demigod devouring them, making them forever a part of his "family".
The Volcano Manor is besieged by the forces of the Royal Capital.

locations.name: Mohgwyn Palace
locations.summary: Mohgwyn Palace is a sub-region located in Siofra River in Elden Ring.
overview: An island in the underground Siofra River, far to the east of Nokron, Eternal City. The grave of an ancient dynasty civilization can be found here, and it is in these ruins that Mohg, Lord of Blood, has chosen to be the seat of his coming Mohgwyn Dynasty.

A large part of the area is taken up by a blood-red lake, which is the habitat of many abominations. The Mohgwyn Dynasty Mausoleum juts out of the west side of the island, housing the Lord of Blood and his vassals.

There are two possible entrances to this area. The conventional route is via a sending gate on the western edge of Consecrated Snowfield, which leads to a cliff on the southeastern side of the palace. Alternately, by becoming a Pureblood Knight of the Mohgwyn Dynasty, one can obtain a Pureblood Knight's Medal from White Mask Varré, which will teleport the player to the mausoleum entrance at will.
notable_loot: Mohg's Great Rune (dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood)
Remembrance of the Blood Lord (dropped by Mohg, Lord of Blood)

locations.name: Nokron, Eternal City
locations.summary: Nokron, Eternal City is a sub-region located in Siofra River.
overview: One of the Eternal Cities inhabited by the Nox, who were banished underground after invoking the ire of the Greater Will. Nokron houses the Fingerslayer Blade, a blood-drenched fetish made from a corpse which can harm the Greater Will and its vassals, and is proof of the treason of the Nox.

Nokron is notably difficult to access, although a band of slaves-turned-soldiers managed to find their way there, becoming trapped in the subterranean realm after the discover of Ghostflame. While the city is visible from the lower portion of Siofra River, the route to it is only opened after Starscourge Radahn is defeated, which causes a star to fall upon Limgrave, opening a deep crater near Fort Haight.
notable_loot: Silver Tear Mask (dropped by Mimic Tear)
Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor (dropped by Regal Ancestor Spirit)

locations.name: Roundtable Hold
locations.summary:
Roundtable Hold is the main hub area in Elden Ring.
Entry to Roundtable Hold is possible after receiving an invitation from Melina. This can be achieved either by resting at a Site of Grace in Liurnia of the Lakes or Caelid, or by facing Margit, the Fell Omen and then resting at any Site of Grace (winning the fight with Margit is not necessary).

Roundtable Hold can only be accessed via fast travel from the map.
overview: Roundtable Hold was once a gathering place of champions, who would receive the wisdom of the Two Fingers. Great Tarnished champions, such as Vargram the Raging Wolf, Errant Sorcerer Wilhelm, Mad Tongue Alberich, and Roundtable Knight Vyke, all convened in the Hold in the distant past. Presently, however, it is a shadow of its former self, with its present occupants not holding the venerable status of those past heroes.
notes: The Fortified Manor, a building with an identical layout to the Roundtable Hold, is located in the Leyndell, Royal Capital, except that one stands empty.

locations.name: Ainsel River Main
locations.summary: Ainsel River Main is a sub-region located in Ainsel River.
overview: The northern area of Ainsel River, which encompasses Nokstella, Eternal City. The Ainsel River Main is the beginning of the path leading to the Moonlight Altar, a key location in Ranni the Witch's questline.

locations.name: Grand Cloister
locations.summary: Grand Cloister is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A temple complex of the ancient dynasty on the southern edge of the Lake of Rot. The cloister is crawling with Kindred of Rot, many of whom can be found worshiping a Scorpion's Stinger in front of a giant statue of a bearded figure. It is said the dagger is a sacred relic of their sealed Outer God of rot. A canal of Scarlet Rot runs through the temple, fed by a waterfall from the Lake of Rot above.
A coffin on the south-western side will lead to an even deeper area, where Astel, Naturalborn of the Void can be fought.
notable_loot: Golden Seed (dropped by Putrid Tree Spirit)
Remembrance of the Naturalborn (dropped by Astel)

locations.name: Lake of Rot
locations.summary: The Lake of Rot (腐れ湖) is a sub-region of the Ainsel River.
overview: The Lake of Rot is a large cavernous area beneath Liurnia of the Lakes filled with rotting waters. The lake itself is littered with the crumbling remnants of an ancient dynasty. Within the center of the Lake of Rot are obelisks with stone pressure plates that when activated, raise platforms from beneath the lake, creating a pathway. In the southern part of this area, the Grand Cloister is found; a large walkway infested with rotted-flora and fauna.

The divine essence of an Outer God is sealed away in this lake, after it was defeated by a blind swordsman with a flowing sword. The Servants of Rot have a presence here, as a Mushroom Crown is found in the lake and the Kindred of Rot populate the Grand Cloiser.

locations.name: Uhl Palace Ruins
locations.summary: Uhl Palace Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The ruins of an ancient dynastic palace along the Ainsel River, occupied by clay priests who once searched for revelation in service of the dynasty they served. It is located below the Uld Palace Ruins.

The Uhl Palace Ruins are divided into two sections. One is accessed via the path from the Ainsel River Well which begins in Liurnia of the Lakes. The other section can only be accessed via the sending gate in Renna's Rise.

locations.name: Altus Tunnel
locations.summary: Altus Tunnel is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A crystal mine in central Altus Plateau south of the Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau). The mine is populated by crystal miners, who appear to be overseen by marionettes.

The tunnel is connected to the Perfumer's Grotto, with a large cavern joining the two dungeons. A malformed creature from the stars dangles from the ceiling in this space. It is not possible to reach the Perfumer's Grotto side of the cavern from Altus Tunnel, however.

locations.name: Capital Outskirts
locations.summary: Capital Outskirts is a sub-region located in Altus Plateau.
sites_of_grace: Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate

locations.name: Dominula, Windmill Village
locations.summary: Dominula, Windmill Village is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A village in the north of Altus Plateau. The villagers are caught in a rapturous dance, seemingly observing some kind of festival. On the south side of the village, a Stranded Soul cowers in fear of a festive melody, pleading to not be skinned.
Most of the dancers are too caught up in the festivities to attack the player. Those who are not dancing will attack on sight, however, and will alert the rest of the villagers to attack.
At the top of the hill upon which the village stands is a Godskin Apostle, a member of a group that once hunted the gods.
npcs: Millicent (also appears as a summon for Godskin Apostle)
notable_loot: Scouring Black Flame (dropped by Godskin Apostle)

locations.name: East Windmill Pasture
locations.summary: East Windmill Pasture is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A windmill at the northernmost point of Altus Plateau. Here, a gathering of villagers can be found madly dancing around a pile of burning corpses. These corpses will slowly rise to attack when approached.

locations.name: Golden Lineage Evergaol
locations.summary: Golden Lineage Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol at the south-westernmost point of Altus Plateau. It houses a member of the Golden Lineage who practiced grafting, and was captured during the Second Defense of Leyndell.
A Stonesword Key is required to activate the Evergaol.
notable_loot: Godfrey Icon (dropped by Godefroy the Grafted)

locations.name: Highway Lookout Tower (Altus Plateau)
locations.summary: Highway Lookout Tower (Altus Plateau) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A crumbling tower built into the cliffs in north-eastern Altus Plateau overlooking the northern road into the Capital Outskirts.
notable_loot: Ash of War: Lightning Slash (dropped by Scarab)

locations.name: Lux Ruins
locations.summary: Lux Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined structure in south-western Altus Plateau. A small tribe of Demi-Humans has taken up residence here, along with their queen.
npcs: Rya the Scout (if met in Liurnia of the Lakes)
notable_loot: Ritual Sword Talisman (chest after Demi-Human Queen Gilika)

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (Altus Plateau) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Minor Erdtree in northern Altus Plateau, in the midst of a misty wood. Instead of an Erdtree Avatar, this Minor Erdtree is guarded by a giant Wormface, infested with Death Blight

locations.name: Mirage Rise
locations.summary: Mirage Rise is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sorcerer's rise in Altus Plateau, in the valley south-west of the Minor Erdtree. This rise will disappear when approached, and to get it to reappear, one must find and break three phantom crests. An imp statue nearby provides the Mirage Riddle, a map which shows the positions of the crests. Spectral Imps will appear near each crest, and will only stop spawning once the crest has been touched. One crest is hidden beneath an illusory rock, which disappears when attacked. Once all three crests have been broken, the rise will reappear and remain in place.

locations.name: Mt. Gelmir
locations.summary: Mt. Gelmir is a sub-region located in Altus Plateau.

locations.name: Old Altus Tunnel
locations.summary: Old Altus Tunnel is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: An old mining tunnel built into the cliffs north-east of Wyndham Ruins. In order to access the dungeon, two Stonesword Keys are required.

locations.name: Perfumer's Grotto
locations.summary: Perfumer's Grotto is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A cave in Altus Plateau, near the entrance to the Capital Outskirts. The cave has become a haven for Perfumers and the Miranda Blossoms they cultivate.
From the large cavern containing the Malformed Star, it is possible to see part of Altus Tunnel, however it is not possible to access that dungeon from here.

locations.name: Perfumer's Ruins
locations.summary: Perfumer's Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A cluster of ruins in south-western Altus Plateau, occupied by Perfumers, an Omenkiller, and a large number of Miranda Blooms.

locations.name: Sage's Cave
locations.summary: Sage's Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A grotto on the north-eastern edge of a shallow pool in south-western Altus Plateau. The cave is inhabited by Those Who Live in Death, as well as a Black Knife Assassin and an infamous necromancer.
notable_loot: Concealing Veil (dropped by Black Knife Assassin)

locations.name: Sainted Hero's Grave

infobox.boss: Black Knife Assassin; Ancient Hero of Zamor

locations.summary: Sainted Hero's Grave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A Hero's Grave in central Altus Plateau. Many of the enemies here are coated in shadows, and cannot be damaged unless they are lured into circles of light projected by statues.
The entrance is guarded by a Black Knife Assassin, who must be defeated in order to access the grave.
notable_loot: Ancient Dragon Knight Kristoff Ashes (dropped by Ancient Hero of Zamor)

locations.name: Second Church of Marika
locations.summary: Second Church of Marika is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A crumbling church in central Altus Plateau. A key event in Bloody Finger Hunter Yura's questline takes place here, if he was assisted in Limgrave and Liurnia of the Lakes. Yura can be found inside the church, and can be spoken to before he dies. Eleonora will then invade.
enemies: Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger (during Yura's quest event)
Sanguine Noble (before or after Yura's quest event)
notable_loot: Eleonora's Poleblade (dropped by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger)
Purifying Crystal Tear (dropped by Eleonora, Violet Bloody Finger)

locations.name: Stormcaller Church
locations.summary: Stormcaller Church is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A church in central Altus Plateau, south of Sainted Hero's Grave. A Sword Monument nearby commemorates the War against the Ancient Dragons, when Godwyn the Golden befriended Fortissax. An incantation of the Ancient Dragon Cult is stored here.

locations.name: The Shaded Castle
locations.summary: The Shaded Castle is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A derelict castle sinking into a poisonous mire in the north of Altus Plateau. For generations, the Shaded Castle was ruled over by House Marais, who served as both executioners and castellans. Maleigh Marais, born sickly like all sons of House Marais, became beguiled by Malenia, claiming to feel her presence when he held the Valkyrie's Prosthesis

Elemer of the Briar, an infamous killer of instructors and merchants, was held in the castle for execution. However, he managed to steal the executioner's sword of House Marais and furnished it with the battle skills of his home of Eochaid, thus avoiding execution. Elemer succeeded in taking over the castle, bringing about the ruin of House Marais. Maleigh Marais can be found wandering the craggy wasteland to the west of the castle.
notable_loot: Marais Executioner's Sword (dropped by Elemer of the Briar)
Briar Greatshield (dropped by Elemer of the Briar)

locations.name: Unsightly Catacombs
locations.summary: Unsightly Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A network of catacombs in the south-west of Altus Plateau, at the base of Mt. Gelmir. In order to access this dungeon, one must use two Stonesword Keys. The catacombs are infested with Omen and Misbegotten, beings scorned by those who follow the Golden Order.
notable_loot: Perfumer Tricia (dropped by Perfumer Tricia & Misbegotten Warrior

locations.name: Village Windmill Pasture
locations.summary: Village Windmill Pasture is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The Village Windmill Pasture sits just west of Dominula, Windmill Village. It is currently occupied by a pair of Misbegotten, while a group of Wandering Nobles cower nearby.

locations.name: West Windmill Pasture
locations.summary: West Windmill Pasture is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A windmill standing on the cliffs in the north-west of Altus Plateau. The stable next to the windmill has become a breeding ground for rats.

locations.name: Woodfolk Ruins
locations.summary: Woodfolk Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined settlement in the deep woods that surround the Minor Erdtree in Altus Plateau. The ruins are inhabited by Wormfaces that produce clouds of Death Blight.
notable_loot: Ash of War: Golden Slam (dropped by Scarab)

locations.name: Writheblood Ruins
locations.summary: Writheblood Ruins is a Landmark located in Altus Plateau.

locations.name: Wyndham Ruins
locations.summary: Wyndham Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A flooded, ruined settlement at the base of Mt. Gelmir. The ruins are overrun by Those Who Live in Death, led by a Tibia Mariner.

locations.name: Abandoned Cave
locations.summary: Abandoned Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring
overview: A cave etched into the cliffs in northern Caelid, above the ravine leading to the Deep Siofra Well. The cave is swamped in Scarlet Rot, and littered with the inactive husks of Iron Virgins.

The cave can be accessed by crossing a root from the west side of the ravine to the east, past an operating Iron Virgin. Inside the cave, geysers of rot burst from the ground at intervals. Deep within the chamber, two stragglers from Malenia's army can be found.
Go directly east from the Smoldering Wall site of grace.

locations.name: Caelem Ruins
locations.summary: Caelem Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruin in the north-west of Caelid, east of the Shack of the Rotting. The ruin is littered with exploding Putrid Corpses and patrolled by Flame Chariots. A pair of Pumpkin Heads reside in the cellar below the structure.
bosses: Mad Pumpkin Head (Hammer) & Mad Pumpkin Head (Flail)
notable_loot: Visage Shield (dropped by Mad Pumpkin Heads)

locations.name: Caelid Catacombs
locations.summary: Caelid Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring
overview: A Scarlet Rot-infested catacombs in the south of Caelid, built into the cliffs below the Cathedral of Dragon Communion. Much of the ground is taken up by swampy water which will cause Scarlet Rot buildup. The grave is essentially linear, with a single path from the entrance to the boss room.
notable_loot: Kindred of Rot Ashes (dropped by Cemetery Shade)

locations.name: Caelid Colosseum
locations.summary:
Caelid Colosseum is a location in Elden Ring.

It's the setting for Spirit Ash-enabled versions of the United Combat, Combat Ordeals, and Duels modes of Arena Combat.

locations.name: Caelid Waypoint Ruins
locations.summary: Caelid Waypoint Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruin in western Caelid, west of the Swamp of Aeonia. It is infested with rot worshippers, and the cellar appears to serve as a hatchery for larval pests.

locations.name: Cathedral of Dragon Communion
locations.summary: Cathedral of Dragon Communion is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A church in southern Caelid where Dragon Communion is practiced. Incantations can be obtained in exchange for Dragon Hearts. The church is guarded by knights who wield draconic powers, while a dragon infested by Scarlet Rot prowls nearby.
Unlike the limited selection at the Church of Dragon Communion, all Dragon Communion Incantations can be bought here.

locations.name: Church of the Plague
locations.summary: Church of the Plague is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A church that sits on the cliffs to the east of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Millicent, the adopted daughter of Sage Gowry, can be found here, immobilised by the Scarlet Rot that infects her.

locations.name: Deep Siofra Well
locations.summary: Deep Siofra Well is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: An ancient structure in a deep ravine in northern Caelid. Inside is a lift which connects Caelid to Siofra River. As the ravine is inaccessible from the rest of Caelid, the only way to access this area is by taking the lift up from beside the Below the River Well Site of Grace in northeastern Siofra River, requiring two Stonesword Keys to activate it.
The ravine branches in two directions from the well. Travelling south will lead to a one-way drop to the Swamp of Aeonia, while the western path leads to the Great Jar and the Caelid Colosseum.
enemies: Sentry Stone (Standing variant and Explosive variant only)

locations.name: Forsaken Ruins
locations.summary: Forsaken Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sprawling ruin at the foot of the cliffs below the Shack of the Rotting in Caelid. Many Trina's Lilies grow here, and a cellar that requires a Stonesword Key to open contains the Sword of St. Trina.

locations.name: Fort Gael
locations.summary: Fort Gael is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A fort occupied by the forces of General Radahn. The front is heavily fortified and manned by torch-wielding soldiers and an archer who commands gravitational abilities. A lion is confined within the fort, but can only be fought after scaling the outside of the structure and dropping down from above.

locations.name: Gael Tunnel
locations.summary: Gael Tunnel is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A series of mines connecting Caelid to Limgrave. The mine is patrolled by Radahn Soldiers and inhabited by Land Octopuses. There is an entrance in Limgrave, however it is locked from the inside. The entrance, just south of the Shack of the Rotting, is guarded by two soldiers, and once inside there is a vertical shaft with a series of platforms which must be navigated to get to the main part of the dungeon.

locations.name: Gaol Cave
locations.summary: Gaol Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring
overview: A cave beneath Fort Gael which has been converted into a prison, accessible by crossing a pool of Scarlet Rot and unlocked using a Stonesword Key. The intricate cave system features many locked cells, containing enemies and loot. In the depths of the cave is a chamber occupied by vulgar militiamen, as well as a lever which will unlock the cells when pulled.
The boss room opens onto a cliff in Limgrave.

locations.name: Gowry's Shack
locations.summary: Gowry's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A small shack on the outskirts of Sellia, Town of Sorcery, just north of Sellia Gateway. Its occupant, Sage Gowry, is knowledgeable about Sellia's secrets, and in search of a needle that can be used to save his adopted daughter, Millicent
npcs: Millicent (after giving her the Unalloyed Gold Needle)
notable_loot: Sellia's Secret (given by Gowry after retrieving the Unalloyed Gold Needle)

locations.name: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow
locations.summary: Greyoll's Dragonbarrow is a sub-region located in Caelid.
overview: A large plateau to Caelids's north. Elder Dragon Greyoll and her children, the Dragons, made their nest here after escaping the Scarlet Rot, earning it it's name.

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (Caelid)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (Caelid) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Minor Erdtree in north-western Caelid. Its protector has been infected by the Scarlet Rot. The entrance to the Minor Erdtree Catacombs lies just behind the tree.
notable_loot: Greenburst Crystal Tear (dropped by Putrid Avatar)
Flame-Shrouding Cracked Tear (dropped by Putrid Avatar)

locations.name: Minor Erdtree Catacombs
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring
overview: Catacombs built at the foot of the Minor Erdtree in Caelid. It is patrolled by Imps, and the lower level is flooded with Scarlet Rot.
bosses: Erdtree Burial Watchdog (Scepter) and Erdtree Burial Watchdog (Sword)
notable_loot: Mad Pumpkin Head Ashes (dropped by Erdtree Burial Watchdog)

locations.name: Sellia Crystal Tunnel
locations.summary: Sellia Crystal Tunnel is a dungeon in Elden Ring
overview: A cave network laden with crystals, north-west of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Miners labour in the mine shafts, overseen by insectoid Kindred of Rot.
It is possible to access this area via a teleporting trap chest in Dragon-Burnt Ruins in Limgrave.
notable_loot: Somber Smithing Stone 6 (dropped by Fallingstar Beast)

locations.name: Sellia Evergaol
locations.summary: Sellia Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol west of Sellia, Town of Sorcery, overlooking the Swamp of Aeonia. A Battlemage from the Academy of Raya Lucaria has been imprisoned here.
notable_loot: Battlemage Hugues Ashes (dropped by Battlemage Hugues)

locations.name: Sellia Gateway
locations.summary: Sellia Gateway is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A gate that stands at the southern entrance to Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Gowry's Shack can be found just beyond the gate. The top of the gate can be accessed from the cliffs above the town.

locations.name: Sellia Hideaway

infobox.boss: Putrid Crystalian (Staff), Putrid Crystalian (Ringblade) & Putrid Crystalian (Spear)

locations.summary: Sellia Hideaway is a dungeon in Elden Ring
overview: A crystal cave north-east of Sellia, Town of Sorcery and the Church of the Plague, hidden behind an illusory wall in the cliffs behind the cemetery. As well as the miners who can be found harvesting the crystals, the cave is also home to a number of sorcerers. One of the founding sorcerers of the Academy of Raya Lucaria has hidden away here, protected by a seal that can only be broken by a Sellian Sealbreaker.
bosses: Putrid Crystalian (Staff), Putrid Crystalian (Ringblade) & Putrid Crystalian (Spear)
notable_loot: Stars of Ruin (given by Primeval Sorcerer Lusat)
Lusat's Set (found where Lusat was after progressing Sorceress Sellen's questline)

locations.name: Sellia, Town of Sorcery
locations.summary: Sellia, Town of Sorcery is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A town in Caelid on the eastern bank of the Swamp of Aeonia. Sellian sorcerers are assassins who are said to hunt their fellow sorcerers, employing night sorceries that allowed them to turn their weapons, or their own bodies, invisible to deceive their enemies.

The Eternal City of Nokron sleeps below Sellia, and it is said that the Sellians are descended from the city's inhabitants. Primeval Sorcerer Lusat, one of the founding Glintstone Sorcerers, came from Sellia. Other Sellian sorcerers followed in Lusat's footsteps, travelling to the Academy of Raya Lucaria to study the Olivinus Conspectus.

General Radahn studied gravity sorcery in Sellia in his youth, learning from an Alabaster Lord. The knowledge he gained allowed him to challenge the stars during the Starscourge Conflict, where he held the town of Sellia secure.

Presently, the town is inhabited by spectral Glintstone Sorcerers and mechanical marionettes, and many of the buildings have been ensnared by the roots that trail from the nearby swamp. Several buildings are protected by seals, which can be broken by lighting the flames at the tops of the town's three towers. Lighting all three will break the seal that blocks the entrance to the chair-crypt, where two former inhabitants of the Eternal Cities reside.
notable_loot: Stonesword Key (On a thin connecting arch along the southern portion of the main street)
Imbued Sword Key (found in a chest in the north-eastern part of the town, behind a seal broken by lighting one of the braziers.)
"Redmane" Painting (In a crumbling house along the main street)
Cerulean Tear Scarab (On a rooftop accessible past the easternmost beacon tower.)
Spelldrake Talisman +1 (found in a chest in the north-western part of the town, behind a seal broken by lighting one of the braziers.)
Night Comet (found in a chest in the central part of the town, behind a seal broken by lighting one of the braziers.)
Staff of Loss (On a corpse hanging from a balcony, accessible by jumping along the rooftops.
Lusat's Glintstone Staff (found in a chest at the back of the Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk boss room, only accessible after defeating the boss.
Nox Flowing Sword (dropped by Nox Swordstress & Nox Monk)

locations.name: Shack of the Rotting
locations.summary: Shack of the Rotting is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A small, run-down shack on the western side of Caelid, overlooking the rot-stricken region.

locations.name: Smoldering Church
locations.summary: Smoldering Church is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A perpetually burning church on the border between Limgrave and Caelid.
notable_loot: Sacred Scorpion Charm (dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater)
Furlcalling Finger Remedy (dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater)

locations.name: Street of Sages Ruins
locations.summary: Street of Sages Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sprawling ruin in the northern section of the Swamp of Aeonia, populated by worshippers of the Scarlet Rot.

locations.name: Swamp Lookout Tower
locations.summary: Swamp Lookout Tower is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A crumbling watchtower on the cliffs south-west of Sellia, Town of Sorcery, overlooking the Swamp of Aeonia. A Bloodhound Knight guards the tower, inside which is a prison cell containing a Sellian sorcery.

locations.name: Swamp of Aeonia
locations.summary: Swamp of Aeonia is a sub-region located in Caelid.
overview: A vast swamp in the centre of Caelid, mired in Scarlet Rot. The final battle between General Radahn and Malenia, Blade of Miquella took place here, during which the Scarlet Aeonia bloomed and engulfed the region in rot. The remnants of Malenia's Cleanrot army can still be found in the swamp.
notable_loot: Unalloyed Gold Needle (dropped by Commander O'Niel)

locations.name: Wailing Dunes
locations.summary: Wailing Dunes is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A vast expanse of sand on the eastern coast of Caelid. The dunes are littered with the corpses of great warriors who participated in The Shattering, their weapons discarded in piles. Starscourge Radahn, his mind lost to Scarlet Rot, is encountered in this area, which is accessed via a sending gate at the bottom of the lift in Redmane Castle.
At the northernmost point is the entrance to the War-Dead Catacombs.

locations.name: War-Dead Catacombs
locations.summary: War-Dead Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: Catacombs found in the cliffs surrounding the Wailing Dunes. The spirits of Radahn's Redmane Knights and Malenia's Cleanrot Knights continue to fight even in death.
notable_loot: Redmane Knight Ogha (dropped by Putrid Tree Spirit)

locations.name: Auriza Hero's Grave
locations.summary: Auriza Hero's Grave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A Hero's Grave tucked away on the outer north-eastern wall of Leyndell, Royal Capital. Automated chariots move along the corridors, and there are many Basilisks throughout. At the end of the dungeon awaits one of the two leaders of the Crucible Knights.

The chariots are summoned by sigils projected onto the ground by statues; one such statue is attached to a fire-breathing pillar. Raising the pillar will move the sigil up onto the same track as the other two chariots; approaching the sigil in its new location to summon this chariot will then result in the chariots colliding, destroying them. Once all three chariots are destroyed, Ash of War: Holy Ground and the Tree Sentinel Set are granted.
The pillar can be raised from afar with Margit's Shackle to avoid a significant amount of effort.
notable_loot: Ash of War: Holy Ground (acquired after destroying three chariots)
Tree Sentinel Set (acquired after destroying three chariots)
Crucible Axe Set (dropped by Crucible Knight Ordovis)
Ordovis's Greatsword (dropped by Crucible Knight Ordovis)

locations.name: Auriza Side Tomb
locations.summary: Auriza Side Tomb is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A catacombs to the north of the Auriza Hero's Grave. Although it may initially seem like a standard catacomb, the layout is deceptively complex. Trapped chests are used to move between different sections of the tomb, with many areas having identical layouts, creating a disorienting effect.
notable_loot: Soldjars of Fortune Ashes (dropped by Grave Warden Duelist)

locations.name: Divine Tower of West Altus
locations.summary: Divine Tower of West Altus is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Divine Tower south-west of Leyndell, Royal Capital. It can only be accessed by passing through the Sealed Tunnel.
At the top of the tower, the player may restore power to Rykard's Great Rune by interacting with a glowing Rune in front of the corpse of a Two Fingers
sites_of_grace: Divine Tower of West Altus: Gate

locations.name: Hermit Merchant's Shack
locations.summary: Hermit Merchant's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A shack close to the wall in the north-western portion of the Capital Outskirts, inhabited by a merchant.

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (Capital Outskirts)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (Capital Outskirts) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A withered, almost leafless Minor Erdtree in the north of the Capital Outskirts. This Minor Erdtree is not guarded by an Erdtree Avatar or an Ulcerated Tree Spirit; instead, a unique Omen capable of casting death sorceries is found surrounded by Commoners. This Minor Erdtree's Crystal Tears are found in a basin nearby.

locations.name: Minor Erdtree Church
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree Church is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined church in the southern portion of the Capital Outskirts. A Minor Erdtree, not yet fully formed, can be found at the back of the church. It is unclear whether it has yet to finish growing, or withered before it could.

locations.name: Sealed Tunnel
locations.summary: Sealed Tunnel is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A mining tunnel in the south-eastern Capital Outskirts. An illusory wall in the cave containing the Site of Grace conceals the entrance to the dungeon proper, and a second illusory wall in the next cave hides a lift which leads to the rest of the dungeon.
The tunnel eventually leads to a fight against an Onyx Lord, beyond which is an opening which allows access to the Divine Tower of West Altus.
notable_loot: Onyx Lord's Greatsword (dropped by Onyx Lord)

locations.name: Albinauric Rise
locations.summary: Albinauric Rise is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sorcerer's rise on the east side of Consecrated Snowfield. The entrance to the tower is sealed, and a puzzle must be solved to open it. A statue depicting two imps fighting offers a clue to the solution.

Phantom Imps will spawn continuously around the outside of the tower. Using a Bewitching Branch or several Crystal Darts on one will cause it to become hostile towards the other Imps, causing them to fight, unlocking the door. Alternately, the Fanged Imp Ashes can be used to summon a spirit Imp to fight the others, also resulting in the door becoming unsealed.

locations.name: Apostate Derelict
locations.summary: Apostate Derelict is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined church at the northernmost point of Consecrated Snowfield, beyond the Wandering Mausoleum. A towering Albinauric woman can be found within- finding her marks the end of Latenna's quest.
notable_loot: Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone (given by Latenna after finishing her questline)

locations.name: Cave of the Forlorn
locations.summary: Cave of the Forlorn is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: An icy cave in eastern Consecrated Snowfield, on the north bank of the frozen river. The two levels are separated by a thick sheet of ice, allowing one to glimpse the lower level from above. The cave is inhabited by Misbegotten and hostile Spirit Jellyfish. At the bottom is a Misbegotten Warrior who wields a greatsword once owned by Radagon of the Golden Order.
Go north-east from the Inner Consecrated Snowfield site of grace. It's pretty much right below the tree on the map.
notable_loot: Golden Order Greatsword (dropped by Misbegotten Crusader)

locations.name: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs
locations.summary: Consecrated Snowfield Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A chilly catacombs in the south-eastern Consecrated Snowfield. The dungeon contains two pillars that emit jets of Frostbite-inflicting mist, which can be disabled by hitting them. There are also Erdtree Burial Watchdogs and Cleanrot Knights scattered throughout.
notable_loot: Great Grave Glovewort (dropped by Putrid Grave Warden Duelist)
Rotten Gravekeeper Cloak (dropped by Putrid Grave Warden Duelist)

locations.name: Hidden Path to the Haligtree
locations.summary: Hidden Path to the Haligtree is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A hidden catacomb only accessible from the Grand Lift of Rold after obtaining both halves of the Haligtree Secret Medallion. The dungeon leads to the Consecrated Snowfield, and can be passed through without completing it. However, a series of invisible walkways lead to a lower section of the tomb, where a stray Mimic Tear can be encountered.
notable_loot: Blackflame Monk Amon Ashes (dropped by Stray Mimic Tear)

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (Consecrated Snowfield) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A husk of a Minor Erdtree in north-eastern Consecrated Snowfield. Its guardian is infested with Scarlet Rot.
notable_loot: Thorny Cracked Tear (dropped by Putrid Avatar)
Ruptured Crystal Tear (dropped by Putrid Avatar)

locations.name: Ordina, Liturgical Town
locations.summary: Ordina, Liturgical Town is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A small town in the north of the Consecrated Snowfield. Ordina is the final stop on the path to Miquella's Haligtree, although to gain entry, one must dispel a magical barrier. An Evergaol on the north side of town will allow the player to enter a version of the town inhabited by many Albinauric Archers, as well as two invisible Black Knife Assassins. There are four candles held by statues in the town, which must be lit in order to open the way to the Haligtree. The candles will remain lit even if the player dies after lighting them.

In the regular version of the town, the spirits of the Albinauric Archers, their wolves, and the assassins, can be seen wandering through the streets, although they cannot be fought or interacted with.

locations.name: Yelough Anix Ruins
locations.summary: Yelough Anix Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined settlement on the western border of the Consecrated Snowfield. The inhabitants have all been taken by Madness, and harbour the Flame of Frenzy within them.

locations.name: Yelough Anix Tunnel
locations.summary: Yelough Anix Tunnel is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A frozen mine located below the Yelough Anix Ruins on the south-western side of the Consecrated Snowfield. As well as miners, the tunnels are also home to Alabaster and Onyx Lords, and deep within lurks Astel, a malformed star.
notable_loot: Meteorite of Astel (dropped by Astel, Stars of Darkness)

locations.name: Godwyn the Golden
locations.summary: Godwyn the Golden was a demigod and son of Queen Marika the Eternal and Godfrey, First Elden Lord. On the Night of Black Knives, he was murdered by the Black Knife Assassins who used ritual daggers imbued with a fragment of the Rune of Death.
overview: [Life]

Godwyn was the son of Queen Marika the Eternal and her consort and first Elden Lord, Godfrey, making him a scion of the so-called "Golden Lineage", of which Godrick the Grafted was the final descendant.

During his mother's reign, the Erdtree came under assault by the Dragons, who had ruled the world before Marika's ascent. The forces of the Erdtree managed to triumph against the dragons, with Godwyn prevailing against the dreaded Fortissax, earning the mighty dragon's friendship in the process.

This friendship between former foes led to the establishment of the capital’s Ancient Dragon Cult, in which Leyndell Knights could learn dragon incantations. Fortissax’s own sister, the dragon Lansseax, took the form of a human to commune with the knights as a priestess of the cult. The cult was allowed within the Golden Order since its seal, and lightning itself, were both imbued with gold. The red-hued incantations were also taught in secret.
[Death]

Godwyn would eventually meet his end during the Night of Black Knives. Seeking to be free from her fate as a pawn of the Greater Will, Godwyn's step-sister Lunar Princess Ranni stole a fragment of the Rune of Death from Maliketh, imbuing the weapons of Numen assassins with it through a fearsome rite. His death was the first recorded death of a demigod, and served as the catalyst for the shattering of the Elden Ring and the subsequent war that broke out between his siblings and stepsiblings.

While Godwyn was believed to be the first dead among the demigods, he and Ranni both died at the same time. As a result, each was branded with one half of the Cursemark of Death. Ranni's flesh perished while Godwyn perished in soul alone. He was buried at the Erdtree's roots below Leyndell, but as he was lacking a soul, his body was unable to die a true death. Some, including his younger half-brother Miquella and his companion Fortissax, tried to cure him of his condition and allow him a proper death, but to no avail. The ancient dragon Fortissax would unsuccessfully try to fight against the Death within Godwyn, but was ultimately corrupted by the blight, becoming a Lichdragon. Godwyn's personal guard became known as the Death Knights, and quested for their master's cadaver surrogates, which would lead them to the catacombs of the Realm of Shadow.
[Prince of Death]

The living body, lacking a soul and unable to die a true death, transformed into an unrecognisable abberation, and became known as the Prince of Death. Deathroot sprouted from it, spreading across the Lands Between through the roots of the Erdtree, and giving rise to Those Who Live in Death.

The deathbed companion Fia would become a leading figure among Those Who Live in Death, eventually making her way to the Prince's throne. With the help from a Tarnished champion, Fia gathers the other two halves of the cursemark, one from Ranni's discarded body and the other from Godwyn's body, and she then lays with Godwyn to grant him a second life as the Prince of Death. As a result of their union, Fia conceived a rune which a champion seeking to become Elden Lord might use to mend the Elden Ring, introducing the principle of life within death into the Golden Order.
notes: The Prince of Death's Pustule and Prince of Death's Cyst feature his face multiplying.

locations.name: The Nameless Eternal City
locations.summary: The Nameless Eternal City is a location in the Deeproot Depths in Elden Ring.
overview: One of the Eternal Cities once inhabited by the Nox. The Nameless Eternal City was most likely assailed by Astel, Naturalborn of the Void and, as a result, destroyed and dispossessed of its artificial night sky.

locations.name: Church of Repose
locations.summary: Church of Repose is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A church on the south-western side of Flame Peak, west of the Forge of the Giants. Bloody Finger Okina will invade near the entrance to the church.
notable_loot: Rivers of Blood (dropped by Bloody Finger Okina)
Okina Mask (dropped by Bloody Finger Okina)

locations.name: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave
locations.summary: Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A Hero's Grave in the south-western region of the Mountaintops of the Giants, close to Flame Peak. Many relics associated with the War Against the Giants can be found in this network of catacombs. It is patrolled by Fire Monks, and the bodies of Trolls are laid to rest in alcoves within the walls. This Hero's Grave also contains shaded creatures, which can only be defeated by luring them into circles of light on the ground.
notable_loot: Zamor Curved Sword (dropped by Ancient Hero of Zamor)
Zamor Set (dropped by Ancient Hero of Zamor)

locations.name: Bestial Sanctum
locations.summary: Bestial Sanctum is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: An ancient structure on the northernmost tip of Caelid. It is the dwelling place of Gurranq, Beast Clergyman, a mysterious individual who seeks Deathroot to consume.
It is possible to drop down the cliff on the western side of the sanctum in order to obtain the Cinquedea and Dragoncrest Shield Talisman.
notes: The architecture matches that seen in Crumbling Farum Azula, and the corpses of many Beastmen can be found surrounding the sanctum, positioned similar to those seen in Farum Azula.

locations.name: Divine Tower of Caelid
locations.summary: Divine Tower of Caelid is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Divine Tower in the northern section of Greyoll's Dragonbarrow in Caelid. The Divine Tower of Caelid is unique among Divine Towers, as the only way to access it is to scale the outside, making use of narrow platforms and ladders. In addition, the interior of the Divine Tower can also be explored once the player has ascended to the mid-point.
At the top of the tower, the player may restore power to Radahn's Great Rune by interacting with the glowing Rune in front of the corpse of a Two Fingers.
notable_loot: Godskin Apostle Set (dropped by Godskin Apostle)

locations.name: Dragonbarrow Cave

infobox.boss: Beastman of Farum Azula (Throwing Knife) & Beastman of Farum Azula (Cleaver)

locations.summary: Dragonbarrow Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring
overview: A cave teeming with nature, in the cliffs below the Minor Erdtree (Dragonbarrow). The cave is inhabited by ferocious wildlife, and a pair of Beastmen reside in the deepest section.
bosses: Beastman of Farum Azula (Throwing Knife) & Beastman of Farum Azula (Cleaver)
notable_loot: Flamedrake Talisman +2 (dropped by Beastman of Farum Azula)

locations.name: Fort Faroth
locations.summary: Fort Faroth is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A fortress on the eastern cliffs of Greyoll's Dragonbarrow in Caelid. Fort Faroth is manned by spectral Redmane forces, and infested with vermin. One half of the medallion required to activate the Grand Lift of Dectus is kept here.

locations.name: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Dragonbarrow)
locations.summary: Isolated Merchant's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ramshackle hut on the north-western side of Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. It is inhabited by a merchant.
notable_loot: Gravity Stone Peddler's Bell Bearing (dropped by Bell Bearing Hunter)

locations.name: Lenne's Rise
locations.summary: Lenne's Rise is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sorcerer's rise on the northern peninsula of Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, south-east of the Farum Greatbridge. The door is sealed, and the imp statue outside has been broken, denying entrance. In order to get inside, one must make use of the nearby spirit spring to jump onto the roof using Torrent, and then drop down onto the balcony on the southern face of the tower.
notes: A giant silver tear will spawn as the player rides west from the site of grace. If the player jumps quickly to the right and back, the tear will roll off the edge. This can net the player an easy 1952 runes and can be repeated quickly, making this an easy way to get runes in the very early game.

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (Dragonbarrow)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (Dragonbarrow) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Minor Erdtree on the eastern cliffs of Greyoll's Dragonbarrow. The surrounding area is mired in Scarlet Rot, which has also affected its guardian.

locations.name: Divine Tower of East Altus
locations.summary: Divine Tower of East Altus is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Divine Tower south-east of Leyndell, Royal Capital, connected to the city via a greatbridge. When crossing the bridge, the player will be transported to a pitch black space and accosted by the Fell Twins. After defeating them, the player will find themselves at the gate to the tower.
Morgott's Great Rune and Mohg's Great Rune can both be restored at the top of this tower, by interacting with the corresponding Rune in front of the corpse of a Two Fingers.
sites_of_grace: Divine Tower of East Altus: Gate

locations.name: Leyndell Catacombs
locations.summary: Leyndell Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A network of catacombs beneath Leyndell, Royal Capital, accessed via the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds. The layout of the catacombs is disorienting, as many of the chambers and hallways are identical to one another, including a room that has the same appearance as the boss rooms in many other catacombs. Omen have made their home here, likely having wandered in from the Shunning-Grounds. A blood priest of Mohg also resides here, accompanied by two bloodthirsty hounds.
The entrance to the dungeon is in a large room containing Crayfish, south of the Underground Roadside Site of Grace.
notable_loot: Lord of Blood's Exultation (dropped by Esgar, Priest of Blood)

locations.name: Artist's Shack
locations.summary: Artist's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The Artist's Shack is located to the north-west of Mistwood. A large painting is on display in this abandoned shack, left behind by an unknown artist.

locations.name: Callu Baptismal Church
locations.summary: Callu Baptismal Church is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A church on the Weeping Peninsula, on the southern side of the Ailing Village. A pack of frenzied rats has made a home here. Despite the frenzy afflicting the adjoining village, it appears that this was once a church dedicated to Queen Marika the Eternal, and a statue in her likeness still stands inside.

locations.name: Cave of Knowledge
locations.summary: Cave of Knowledge is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
