overview: The player first enters the Cave of Knowledge after dropping down from the Stranded Graveyard. The cave serves as a tutorial, teaching the player the game's combat mechanics. After defeating the Soldier of Godrick, the player will find themselves returned to the Stranded Graveyard, rewarded with the Strength gesture.

locations.name: Chapel of Anticipation
locations.summary: Chapel of Anticipation is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: Chapel of Anticipation is the first location the player encounters when they begin the game. It consists of a small chapel, a wide-open courtyard, and crumbling path. In order to leave this location, the player needs to either be killed by the Grafted Scion that attacks upon entering the courtyard, or fall off the cliff. Upon doing so, the player will encounter Melina and Torrent for the first time, and wake up in the Stranded Graveyard.

The player may return to the area later via a Sending Gate in The Four Belfries in Liurnia of the Lakes, located at the Belfry with the hint "Precipice of Anticipation". Upon returning, a door at the side of the chapel will now be unlocked, allowing the player to pick up Stormhawk Deenh and The Stormhawk King.
notable_loot: Ornamental Straight Sword (obtained from the Grafted Scion)
Golden Beast Crest Shield (obtained from the Grafted Scion)

locations.name: Church of Dragon Communion
locations.summary: Church of Dragon Communion is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A church on an isolated island off the west coast on Limgrave, accessible via Coastal Cave. Inside this church is the corpse of an Ancient Dragon, and in front of it, an altar. By offering up Dragon Hearts, the player may learn dragon incantations.
Here, only the Dragonclaw, Dragonmaw, and Dragonfire Dragon Communion Incantations can be bought. For the rest, seek out the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in southern Caelid.

locations.name: Church of Elleh
locations.summary: Church of Elleh is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The Church of Elleh is located just north of the First Step, where the player first emerges after leaving the Stranded Graveyard. The merchant Kalé can be found here as well as a Smithing Table and Site of Grace. After the player meets Melina and unlocks the ability to call on Torrent, Ranni the Witch will appear here under the name "Renna", offering the player the Spirit Calling Bell and Lone Wolf Ashes.

locations.name: Coastal Cave
locations.summary: Coastal Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A cave on the west coast of Limgrave. A tribe of Demi-Humans calls this cave home. Beyond the lair of the clan's chiefs is a passage leading to an island off Limgrave's shore, where the Church of Dragon Communion stands.

locations.name: Deathtouched Catacombs
locations.summary: Deathtouched Catacombs (死に触れた地下墓 (Shi ni Fureta Chika Haka) is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: Deathtouched Catacombs is located to the west of Saintsbridge in the northern part of Stormhill. It is currently inhabited by skeletons, the remains of champions who currently live in death. A Black Knife Assassin hides within the farthest chamber of the catacombs, alongside a Deathroot.
notable_loot: Assassin's Crimson Dagger (obtained from Black Knife Assassin)

locations.name: Demi-Human Forest Ruins
locations.summary: Demi-Human Forest Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined structure in the woods to the north of the Weeping Peninsula. It is currently inhabited by a clan of Demi-Humans and their queen.
notable_loot: Demi-Human Queen's Staff (obtained from Demi-Human Queen)

locations.name: Divine Tower of Limgrave
locations.summary: Divine Tower of Limgrave is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The Divine Tower of Limgrave rises out of the sea to the north of Limgrave, connected to Stormveil Castle by a great bridge which has crumbled in the middle and can only be traversed through the use of a Sending Gate.
A trio of Guardian Golems await on the bridge; two wield axes while a third fires giant arrows on approach.
Once the player has claimed Godrick's Great Rune, they may restore its power at the top of the tower, by interacting with the glowing Rune in front of the corpse of a Two Fingers.

locations.name: Dragon-Burnt Ruins
locations.summary: Dragon-Burnt Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined structure in Lake Agheel. A commune has gathered here in dedication to Flying Dragon Agheel, and their chants can be heard by the player as they approach. A cellar to the south of the ruin holds a twinblade, while another to the north contains a trapped chest which will transport the player to Sellia Crystal Tunnel in Caelid.

locations.name: Forest Lookout Tower
locations.summary: Forest Lookout Tower is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A crumbling watchtower to the west of the Bridge of Sacrifice.

locations.name: Forlorn Hound Evergaol
locations.summary: Forlorn Hound Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol on a hill in the southern reaches of Limgrave. A traitorous Bloodhound Knight dwells within. Later, this same gaol is used to incarcerate Blaidd.
notable_loot: Bloodhound's Fang (obtained from Bloodhound Knight Darriwil)

locations.name: Fort Haight
locations.summary: Fort Haight is a fort in Elden Ring.
overview: The home of Kenneth Haight, this fortress on the eastern coast of Limgrave has been occupied by soldiers from the army of Godrick the Grafted, led by a knight obsessed with blood.
After the player liberates the fort, Kenneth moves back in, along with a small band of Demi-Humans.
notable_loot: Ash of War: Bloody Slash (obtained from the Bloodcrazed Knight)

locations.name: Fringefolk Hero's Grave
locations.summary: Fringefolk Hero's Grave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: This Hero's Grave is connected to the Stranded Graveyard, locked behind a gate which requires two Stonesword Keys to open. This tomb is guarded by Chariot traps, spectral soldiers, and a pair of Grafted Scions.
notable_loot: Golden Seed (obtained from Ulcerated Tree Spirit)
Banished Knight Oleg Ashes (obtained from Ulcerated Tree Spirit)
Dragon Communion Seal (obtained from Banished Knight)

locations.name: Gatefront Ruins
locations.summary: Gatefront Ruins is a ruin in Elden Ring.
overview: Gatefront Ruins is a collapsed structure in front of Stormgate. It currently serves as an encampment for soldiers of Godrick the Grafted, and appears to be the final destination for a number of carriages. A hidden chamber houses a chest containing an Ash of War. Melina can be encountered at the Site of Grace here.

locations.name: Groveside Cave
locations.summary: Groveside Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: Groveside Cave is located a bit west of the road going north near the Church of Elleh. It appears that an encampment was erected inside the cave, however presently it is home only to a pack of wolves and a Beastman from Farum Azula. The cave consists of a narrow passageway which opens into a wider cavern containing a small pool, which in turn leads into another cavern where the Beastman dwells.
notable_loot: Flamedrake Talisman (obtained from Beastman of Farum Azula)

locations.name: Highroad Cave
locations.summary: Highroad Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A hidden cave tucked away near the northern mouth of a river that flows through Limgrave. This network of caverns contains the ruins of an ancient civilisation, and is home to all manner of wildlife.
notable_loot: Blue Dancer Charm (obtained from Guardian Golem)

locations.name: Limgrave Colosseum
locations.summary:
Limgrave Colosseum is a location in Elden Ring.

It's the setting for United Combat and Combat Ordeals modes of Arena Combat.

locations.name: Limgrave Tunnels
locations.summary: Limgrave Tunnels is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: Limgrave Tunnels is a mine located in the northwestern corner of Agheel Lake in Limgrave. Built to excavate Smithing Stones, the galleries consist of a network of tunnels across several levels, separated by lift shafts. The tunnels are inhabited by miners who will use their pickaxes to defend themselves if approached. At the bottom of the mine resides the Stonedigger Troll.
The Limgrave Tunnels Site of Grace is found at the bottom of the lift at the tunnels' entrance.

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (Limgrave)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (Limgrave) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: Towering over the Mistwood, this golden tree is one of the few not protected by an Erdtree Avatar. Crystal Tears have fallen into a basin at the tree's base, and many Scarabs gather around it.
notable_loot: Ash of War: Ground Slam (obtained from Scarab)

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (Weeping Peninsula)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (Weeping Peninsula) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Minor Erdtree on a raised ridge in the Weeping Peninsula, south of the Church of Pilgrimage. This Minor Erdtree is protected by an Erdtree Avatar and a group of Erdtree Guardians.
notable_loot: Crimsonburst Crystal Tear (obtained from Erdtree Avatar)

locations.name: Mistwood Ruins
locations.summary: Mistwood Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruin deep within the Mistwood, currently inhabited by a Runebear. Upon approaching the ruins, the player may hear a distant howling. Blaidd perches on a crumbling tower, and will jump down to greet the player if they use the Finger Snap gesture obtained from Merchant Kalé.

locations.name: Murkwater Catacombs
locations.summary: Murkwater Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: These catacombs are located in a ravine in Limgrave. Imps guard the dungeon, alongside a Grave Warden Duelist. The ashes of an old hero can be found within.

locations.name: Murkwater Cave
locations.summary: Murkwater Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A small cave which is currently home to a group of deserters who have turned to banditry, led by a particularly enterprising individual.
There are tripwires scattered around the opening to the central cavern. Stepping on one will trigger a bell to ring, alerting the enemies.
notable_loot: Patches' Bell Bearing (if Patches is killed)

locations.name: Oridys's Rise
locations.summary: Oridys's Rise is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sorcerer's rise on the eastern side of the Weeping Peninsula. The tower is sealed, with a statue at the front bearing a note that reads "Seek three wise beasts". To gain entry, the player must find and hit three spectral turtles nearby. Once inside, the player can pick up a Memory Stone to increase their memory slots by 1.

locations.name: Siofra River Well
locations.summary: Siofra River Well is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A stone structure in the north-eastern corner of Mistwood, just east of the Minor Erdtree (Limgrave). The building contains a lift which will transport the player to Siofra River, one of the two ancient rivers that run beneath the Lands Between.

locations.name: Stormfoot Catacombs
locations.summary: Stormfoot Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A catacombs located north-west of the Church of Elleh, at the foot of Stormhill. These catacombs are inhabited by imps, and protected by a number of fire-spitting statues.
notable_loot: Noble Sorcerer Ashes (obtained from Erdtree Burial Watchdog)

locations.name: Stormgate
locations.summary: Stormgate is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: Stormgate is located in the southern part of Stormhill, north of Gatefront Ruins. Past the gate lies a narrow corridor where a number of soldiers and a Troll have laid an ambush. The battlements above the passage house a chest containing the Arrow's Reach Talisman.

locations.name: Stormhill
locations.summary: Stormhill is a sub-region located in Limgrave.
overview: Situated in the northwestern portion of Limgrave, Stormhill is perpetually wrapped in strong winds and littered with ancient ruins. The path to Stormveil Castle passes through here.

locations.name: Stormhill Evergaol
locations.summary: Stormhill Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol on a cliff on the south-western side of Stormhill. A Crucible Knight, once loyal to Godfrey, First Elden Lord, is imprisoned here.
notable_loot: Aspects of the Crucible: Tail (obtained from Crucible Knight)

locations.name: Stormhill Shack
locations.summary: Stormhill Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: Stormhill Shack is a small wooden shack in Stormhill, north of Stormgate. A Heartbroken Maiden is found inside the hut, distraught about the loss of her companions.

locations.name: Stranded Graveyard
locations.summary: Stranded Graveyard is a sub-region of Limgrave.
overview: A cavern into which the Tarnished is thrown after their death in the Chapel of Anticipation. It is a small cavern which leads into the Cave of Knowledge. Fringefolk Hero's Grave is also accessed from this area, the entrance to which is locked by an imp statue requiring two Stonesword Keys.

The area can also be accessed from a beach on the south-western coast of Limgrave, where the Haligdrake Talisman can be picked up (though getting down on the beach requires approaching from the Seaside Ruins Site of Grace, southeast of the Graveyard itself).

locations.name: Summonwater Village
locations.summary: Summonwater Village is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: Summonwater Village is a seemingly abandoned settlement in the eastern region of Limgrave. The village is flooded, and inhabited by Those Who Live in Death, led by a Tibia Mariner.
In the south-eastern part of the village is a cellar, sealed by an imp statue, in which a number of turtles dwell.

locations.name: Third Church of Marika
locations.summary: Third Church of Marika is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The Third Church of Marika is located in the eastern portion of Limgrave, just north of Mistwood. Resting at the Site of Grace here will allow the player to hear an echo of Marika from Melina, in which she addresses her lord and his warriors, announcing the removal of their Grace and their subsequent banishment.

locations.name: Wandering Mausoleum
locations.summary: Wandering Mausoleums are large, mobile structures in Elden Ring which serve as means to duplicate Remembrances.
overview: The Wandering Mausoleums are the resting places of soulless demigods who are Marika's unwanted children. They take the form of large buildings mounted atop four legs, which wander around set areas throughout the Lands Between. Some Mausoleums have massive bells hanging from the undersides of their structures which can be heard from afar, ringing to constantly mourn its soulless demigods. Most have skull-like formations in their feet which disappear and release a small amount of ghostflame when hit.

They are often guarded by Mausoleum Knights and Mausoleum Soldiers, who beheaded themselves in order to follow their masters into death, a self-inflicted curse that ties their spirits to the land. Their armor depicts the mausoleum bell, and the knights don wing-shaped ornamentations that evoke the Deathbirds.

The shields of the Mausoleum Knights is emblazoned with the eclipsed sun, which is a symbol of the Mausoleums. The eclipse is the protective star of the soulless demigods and aids the Mausoleum Knights in keeping Destined Death at bay.

locations.name: Warmaster's Shack
locations.summary: Warmaster's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: Warmaster's Shack is a small hut in the woods north of Stormgate. It is the home of Bernahl, a knight who offers the player Ashes of War.
At night, a Bell Bearing Hunter may appear in this location.
notable_loot: Bone Peddler's Bell Bearing (obtained from Bell Bearing Hunter)

locations.name: Waypoint Ruins
locations.summary: Waypoint Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sprawl of ruined structures to the east of Agheel Lake. Several Miranda Flowers have sprouted on the surface, and a Mad Pumpkin Head lurks below. A sorceress has also set up shop here.

locations.name: Weeping Evergaol
locations.summary: Weeping Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol in the western region of Weeping Peninsula, just north-east of Fourth Church of Marika. A Stonesword Key is required to unlock this Evergaol. Imprisoned within is a hero of Zamor.
notable_loot: Radagon's Scarseal (obtained from Ancient Hero of Zamor)

locations.name: Weeping Peninsula
locations.summary: The Weeping Peninsula is a sub-region of Limgrave.
overview: The Weeping Peninsula is the southern-most tip of the Lands Between. The peninsula derives its name from its unceasing rainfall, giving the impression of a land in constant lament. It is connected to Limgrave proper by the Bridge of Sacrifice to its north.

Castle Morne stands on the southernmost tip of the peninsula. Currently presided over by Castellan Edgar on the appointment of Godrick the Grafted, the castle was once the site of a battle between a lone hero and Godfrey, First Elden Lord.

locations.name: Academy Crystal Cave
locations.summary: Academy Crystal Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A cave beneath the Academy of Raya Lucaria, rich in crystals. It is currently inhabited by a small group of scholars from the academy, as well as a pair of Crystalians. Beyond the chamber where the Crystalians live is a lift to the top of the academy's highest belfry.
This dungeon requires two Stonesword Keys to enter.

locations.name: Academy Gate Town
locations.summary: Academy Gate Town is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sprawling township to the south-east of Academy of Raya Lucaria, currently sinking into the lake. Albinaurics reside among the crumbling buildings, while the upper district is patrolled by the Cuckoo Knights.

locations.name: Ainsel River Well
locations.summary: Ainsel River Well is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A structure in eastern Liurnia, containing a lift which leads to the subterranean Ainsel River.

locations.name: Artist's Shack (Liurnia)
locations.summary: Artist's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A small shack on the eastern side of Liurnia, north-west of Carian Study Hall. A painting is displayed inside.

locations.name: Bellum Church
locations.summary: Bellum Church is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A church built on the side of the highway leading to the Grand Lift of Dectus, the entrance to Altus Plateau. Characterized for having a Radagon statue, instead of the usual Marika.
Hyetta will temporarily reside here, in need of a Fingerprint Grape.
sites_of_grace: ER Site of Grace Bellum Church.png

locations.name: Bellum Highway
locations.summary: Bellum Highway is a sub-region located in Liurnia of the Lakes.
overview: A highway in the northern region of Liurnia, stretching from the Grand Lift of Dectus to the eastern gate of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The highway is patrolled by Raya Lucaria's soldiers, and a number of giant trebuchets have been erected in front of the Grand Lift. The Frenzied Flame Village sits at the top of the cliffs to the south-east of the highway.

locations.name: Black Knife Catacombs
locations.summary:
Black Knife Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.

It is found by heading east from the Church of Vows and taking the south path in the north-south split road. From there, follow the road until another north-east split happens and head north again before the cliffside splits east and follow it.

The entrance to the catacombs is guarded by a Mausoleum Knight.
overview: A catacomb in the north-eastern area of Liurnia, inhabited by Necromancers and Skeletons. The catacombs are said to contain a knifeprint which hides the truth of the conspiracy of the Night of Black Knives.

Skeletons in this dungeon cannot be killed normally after being defeated unless using special weaknesses of Those Who Live in Death. Instead, nearby Commoner's wielding special staves have to be killed to finished them off normally.

The entrance to the main boss arena can be found just after the Site of Grace at the entrance. Head left to find a split in the route, with a Stonesword Key-locked room to the left that holds 2 Skeletons and the Rosus' Axe.
To continue, head forward instead of to the left and run into a large room with 3 guillotines.
[Main boss route]
Run through the guillotine to a ladder and climb down. Straight ahead is the dungeon lever, guarded by 2 Giant Crabs that pop up from the back and the front as you approach.

Return to the entrance and head through the now unlocked door to arrive at the boss, a Cemetery Shade who is accompanied by 2 sword-wielding Skeletons and 1 bow-wielding Skeleton. Since this can be a very overwhelming fight it is recommended to bring a Spirit Ash to distract at least some of the foes, or otherwise bring a strong anti-undead attack such as the skill Sacred Blade to deal with the mobs.
[Secondary boss route]

After the second or third guillotine blade has fallen down in the large room they can be stepped onto and ridden to a ledge above. Following through the door leads to more regular enemies as well as a corridor that seemingly ends with a small hole to the right to drop down to the lever below. If one instead attacks the wall straight ahead another fog wall for a boss will be revealed, along with the summon sign for D, Hunter of the Dead should he be alive.

Since the Black Knife Assassin within is a very agile foe capable of making lunges across the rather small arena, it is advisable to summon D or a Spirit Ash to help keep the assassin's attention on someone else and get a safe moment to heal.
npcs: D, Hunter of the Dead (co-operator vs Black Knife Assassin)
notable_loot: Assassin's Cerulean Dagger (obtained from Black Knife Assassin)
Black Knifeprint (obtained from Black Knife Assassin)
Twinsage Sorcerer Ashes (obtained from Cemetery Shade)

locations.name: Boilprawn Shack
locations.summary: Boilprawn Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: An isolated shack standing on its own in the lake, north-west of the Scenic Isle Site of Grace. Presently, it is occupied by Big Boggart, who is occupied with cooking up freshly caught "prawn" meat.

locations.name: Caria Manor
locations.summary: Caria Manor is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A large estate in the north-west of Liurnia. The manor was once the home of the Carian Royal Family, who ruled over Liurnia and governed the Academy of Raya Lucaria. After the Academy turned on the Carians, the Cuckoo Knights launched an assault on the manor, catching the Carian Knights off guard. However, the Cuckoos were caught in a magic snare which keeps their souls trapped within the manor.
In recent times, there have been rumours of vassals of the royal family gathering in the manor's grounds, possibly including the secretive Ranni the Witch.

locations.name: Carian Study Hall
locations.summary: Carian Study Hall is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: The Carian Study Hall is a building on the eastern coast of Liurnia, to the north of Jarburg. It is connected to the Divine Tower of Liurnia by a great bridge, though it is not accessible initially.

The Study Hall consists of a vast library spanning multiple storeys, accessed by an elevator from a chapel-like entrance hall. The study hall is patrolled by Preceptor Miriam, a sorceress who calls upon blue, spectral nobles and prefers to fight from a distance using magical projectiles.

The hall hides a secret, which is revealed when a Carian Inverted Statue is placed onto a pedestal of a celestial globe in the entrance hall. Doing so flips the entire building upside-down, leading to another encounter with Miriam and revealing the entrance to the Divine Tower of Liurnia.

The player receives the Carian Inverted Statue from Ranni the Witch after bringing her the Fingerslayer Blade. The Divine Tower beyond the study hall hides Ranni's true body, which bears the Cursemark of Death.
enemies: Wandering Noble (puppet, Estoc variant and sorcerer variant only)
Cuckoo Soldier (puppet, Spear variant and Sword variant only)

locations.name: Cathedral of Manus Celes
locations.summary: Cathedral of Manus Celes is a location in Elden Ring. It is located on the Moonlight Altar in Liurnia of the Lakes. This area becomes accessible near the end of Ranni's questline.
overview: A large, dilapidated cathedral sitting atop the Moonlight Altar, a vast plateau overlooking Liurnia. The cathedral is guarded by Adula, a dragon in the service of Ranni the Witch. Within the cathedral itself, a large number of Starlight Shards can be found. Near the back of the church, there is a hole which leads to a small cavern, where Ranni's doll can be found sitting atop the corpse of her Two Fingers.
notable_loot: Dragon Heart (obtained from Glintstone Dragon Adula)
Adula's Moonblade (obtained from Glintstone Dragon Adula)
Dark Moon Greatsword (obtained from Ranni after interacting with her)

locations.name: Chelona's Rise
locations.summary: Chelona's Rise is a location in Elden Ring. Can only be accessed after unlocking the Moonlight Altar region.
overview: A sorcerer's rise on the south-western tip of the Moonlight Altar. The entrance is sealed, with a message by the door reading "Seek three great wise beasts".

In order to enter the tower, the player must locate and attack three giant spectral turtles. The first can be found hanging from the side of a cliff just west of the tower. The second is far to the south-east of the Moonlight Altar, sitting at the edge of a cliff. The third is hovering high in the air to the north-west of the Moonlight Altar, south-west of the Ringleader's Evergaol- to get this one the player must use a spiritspring.
notes: The name is probably inspired by the word "chelonia", which means turtle in Latin.

locations.name: Church of Inhibition
locations.summary: Church of Inhibition is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A run-down church on a hill north-west of the Frenzied Flame Village. On approach, Festering Fingerprint Vyke will invade, dropping a Fingerprint Grape on defeat.
Within the church is the corpse of a Finger Maiden, sitting on a wooden chair. It can be used to taint the Lord of Blood's Favor to advance Varré's questline.

locations.name: Church of Irith
locations.summary: Church of Irith is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A dilapidated church in the south of Liurnia of the Lakes, west of Stormveil Castle. A certain sorcerer has taken shelter here.

locations.name: Church of Vows
locations.summary: Church of Vows is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: An old, crumbling church on the eastern side of Liurnia. The Church of Vows was the site of the marriage between Rennala, Queen of Caria, and Radagon, the red-haired champion of the Erdtree, uniting the houses of the Erdtree and the Moon following their conflict during the Liurnian Wars.
The aged pastor, Miriel, oversees the church despite its dilapidated state. He has in-depth knowledge of the history of Liurnia and the Carian Royal Family, which he is happy to divulge if spoken to.

At the back of the church stands an ornate basin. It is said that Radagon repented his territorial aggression by cleansing himself with dew in this pool. The player may replicate this act here by offering up Celestial Dew, performing an Absolution to render any NPCs that have been attacked non-hostile.
notable_loot: Meat Peddler's Bell Bearing (obtained from Bell Bearing Hunter)

locations.name: Cliffbottom Catacombs
locations.summary: Cliffbottom Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: Catacombs built into the cliffs on the eastern side of Liurnia of the Lakes. Imps guard the catacombs, which also contain several Omen.

locations.name: Converted Fringe Tower
locations.summary: Converted Fringe Tower is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sorcerer's rise in the north-east of Liurnia. The interior of the tower past the entrance foyer is sealed off, with a message reading "May erudition light the way". In order to break the seal and access the rest of the tower, the player must don a Glintstone Crown and perform the Erudition gesture in front of the statue of Marika.
Crowns which can be used to complete this puzzle:
Karolos Glintstone Crown
Olivinus Glintstone Crown
Twinsage Glintstone Crown
Lazuli Glintstone Crown
Witch's Glintstone Crown

locations.name: Converted Tower
locations.summary: Converted Tower is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sorcerer's rise in the western region of Liurnia, just south of the Minor Erdtree (West Liurnia). In order to access the upper levels of the tower, the player must use the Erudition gesture, obtained from Thops, in front of the statue of Marika just inside the entrance. Alternately, Torrent can be used to scale the crumbling walls around the tower, allowing access to the top floor.

locations.name: Cuckoo's Evergaol
locations.summary: Cuckoo's Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol on the western side of Liurnia, where a troll who once served the Carian Royal Family as a knight has been imprisoned.
notable_loot: Greatblade Phalanx (obtained from Bols, Carian Knight)

locations.name: Deep Ainsel Well
locations.summary: Deep Ainsel Well is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A small structure housing an elevator which links the Moonlight Altar to the Lake of Rot. This is where the player will first emerge onto the Moonlight Altar, after defeating Astel, Naturalborn of the Void and obtaining the Dark Moon Ring.

locations.name: Divine Tower of Liurnia
locations.summary: Divine Tower of Liurnia is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The Divine Tower of Liurnia stands on a rocky outcropping off the eastern coast of Liurnia of the Lakes, accessed via the Carian Study Hall. Unlike every other Divine Tower, there is no Great Rune to restore here. Instead, the player will find the corpse of Ranni the Witch, bearing the evidence of her involvement in the Night of Black Knives.

locations.name: Frenzied Flame Village
locations.summary: Frenzied Flame Village is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A settlement in the north-eastern region of Liurnia. The village is beset by the Flame of Frenzy, which corrupts the villagers and Raya Lucaria soldiers alike. It can be found by going up the slope along the cliffside just east of Bellum Church. The Church of Inhibition lies at the top of the village, where Vyke can be first encountered.
notable_loot: Stonesword Key - On a corpse atop the western wall, reachable by jumping down from the ledge above
Frenzied's Cookbook [1] - On a charred corpse near the entrance to the village
Shabriri's Woe - On a corpse surrounded by frenzied Raya Lucaria Soldiers
Note: The Lord of Frenzied Flame - Hidden behind a cottage near the entrance
Frenzied Burst - Obtained from an incantation scarab on the path up to the Church of Inhibition. It is guarded by several frenzed rats

locations.name: Frenzy-Flaming Tower
locations.summary: Frenzy-Flaming Tower is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A watchtower north of the Frenzied Flame Village. A vast, blazing eye periodically manifests over the crumbling tower, rapidly inflicting madness upon anyone in its line of sight. The burning orb is maintained by a group of Frenzied Commoners, and will dissipate if they are killed. The commoners do not respawn, so killing them will permanently deactivate the tower.

locations.name: Highway Lookout Tower (Liurnia)
locations.summary: Highway Lookout Tower is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A crumbling watchtower standing watch over the road along the eastern coast of Liurnia. Spectral nobles will appear around the base when approached, while a sorcerer fires projectile spells from the top level.

locations.name: Jarburg
locations.summary: Jarburg is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A peaceful, secluded village populated by Living Jars, on the eastern coast of Liurnia. The villagers are in need of a Potentate to protect them from poachers.
It contains a multitude of respawning crafting items scattered around the area.
Reaching this area requires some careful jumping down massive gravestones mounted in the side of the cliff above and south of Carian Study Hall, eastern Liurnia of the Lakes.

locations.name: Kingsrealm Ruins
locations.summary: Kingsrealm Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruin to the south of Caria Manor, devastated during the Cuckoo Knights' attack on the Carian Royal Family. It is inhabited by Noble Sorcerers who flicker in and out of sight. A basement hides a Royal Revenant, as well as a chest containing weapon of the Carians. Just past the ruins, the blacksmith and warmaster of the Carians resides.

locations.name: Lakeside Crystal Cave
locations.summary: Lakeside Crystal Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A cave network to the west of the Laskyar Ruins, which jut from the mist-shrouded lake of Liurnia. The cave is inhabited by Demi-Human and crystal snails, and leads to the Slumbering Wolf's Shack where an Albinauric woman resides.
notable_loot: Cerulean Amber Medallion (obtained from Bloodhound Knight)

locations.name: Laskyar Ruins
locations.summary: Laskyar Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A cluster of half-sunken ruins in the southern part of Liurnia of the Lakes. Revenant Followers inhabit the crumbled structures, along with a Royal Revenant

locations.name: Lunar Estate Ruins
locations.summary: Lunar Estate Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A dilapidated estate occupied by Wraithcallers and Revenants, located on the east side of the Moonlight Altar.

locations.name: Malefactor's Evergaol
locations.summary: Malefactor's Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol on the western coastline of Liurnia of the Lakes. Adan, a former Fire Monk who stole a closely guarded incantation from Chief Guardian Arghanthy, is imprisoned within.
notable_loot: Flame of the Fell God (obtained from Adan, Thief of Fire)

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (East Liurnia)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (East Liurnia) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Minor Erdtree east of the Uld Palace Ruins and south of the Frenzied Flame Village. A gathering of Ancestral Followers has congregated nearby, facing the tree and stomping. An Erdtree Avatar guards the Minor Erdtree.
notable_loot: Magic-Shrouding Cracked Tear (obtained from Erdtree Avatar)
Lightning-Shrouding Cracked Tear (obtained from Erdtree Avatar)
Holy-Shrouding Cracked Tear (obtained from Erdtree Avatar)

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (West Liurnia)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (West Liurnia) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Minor Erdtree in the west of Liurnia, protected by Erdtree Guardians and an Erdtree Avatar.
notable_loot: Cerulean Crystal Tear (Obtained from Erdtree Avatar)
Ruptured Crystal Tear (Obtained from Erdtree Avatar)

locations.name: Moonfolk Ruins
locations.summary: Moonfolk Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined complex built on the Moonlight Altar, just north of the Deep Ainsel Well. The ruins are inhabited by noble sorcerers, and protected by glintstone ground traps.

locations.name: Moonlight Altar
locations.summary: Moonlight Altar is a sub-region located in Liurnia of the Lakes. It can only be accessed after considerably advancing Ranni's questline.
overview: A plateau in the southwest of Liurnia, accessible only by passing through Ainsel River and the Lake of Rot and defeating Astel, Naturalborn of the Void. The lift which leads to the Moonlight Altar is sealed, and can only be accessed by obtaining the Dark Moon Ring from the treasure chest in Rennala's library in the Academy of Raya Lucaria.

The plateau, which sits above the Village of the Albinaurics, is the site of the Cathedral of Manus Celes, a large, ruined church. An Evergaol, housing the ringleader of the Black Knife Assassins, can also be found here.
notable_loot: Adula's Moonblade (obtained from Glintstone Dragon Adula)

locations.name: Purified Ruins
locations.summary: Purified Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A cluster of ruined buildings occupied by Raya Lucaria's army. A cellar hides a Shabriri Grape and a Two Fingers Heirloom. Nearby is a Sending Gate that leads to the front gate of Academy of Raya Lucaria.

locations.name: Ranni's Rise
locations.summary: Ranni's Rise is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The dwelling place of Ranni the Witch in the Three Sisters region of Liurnia beyond Caria Manor. It is guarded by Ranni's loyal dragon, Adula, who will retreat after a brief battle.
notable_loot: Carian Inverted Statue (obtained from Ranni during her questline)

locations.name: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel
locations.summary: Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: An extensive network of tunnels and mineshafts to the north-east of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Glintstone miners labour here, overseen by Marionette Soldiers.
notable_loot: Smithing-Stone Miner's Bell Bearing (obtained from Crystalian)

locations.name: Renna's Rise
locations.summary: Renna's Rise is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The northernmost tower of the Three Sisters, located beyond the Caria Manor. The tower, so named by Ranni the Witch, is sealed upon a first visit. After the player has entered Ranni's service and handed her the Fingerslayer Blade, the seal will disappear. Inside is a sending gate which leads to Ainsel River.

locations.name: Revenger's Shack
locations.summary: Revenger's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A small shack on the west side of Liurnia, north of the Minor Erdtree. After the death of Irina of Morne in the Weeping Peninsula, Edgar the Revenger will invade here. A number of Misbegotten corpses can be found leading from the lakeshore to the shack, suggesting that Edgar got his revenge.
notable_loot: Shabriri Grape (obtained from Edgar the Revenger)
Banished Knight's Halberd +8 (Obtained from Edgar the Revenger)

locations.name: Ringleader's Evergaol
locations.summary: Ringleader's Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol on the north-western tip of the Moonlight Altar. The leader of the assassins who slew Godwyn the Golden on the Night of Black Knives is imprisoned within.
notable_loot: Black Knife Tiche (obtained from Alecto, Black Knife Ringleader)

locations.name: Road's End Catacombs
locations.summary: Road's End Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A secluded series of catacombs built into the cliffs of western Liurnia, south-west of the Minor Erdtree (West Liurnia). Illusory walls obscure the route through this dungeon, which is guarded by imps.
notable_loot: Glintstone Sorcerer Ashes (obtained from Spiritcaller Snail)

locations.name: Rose Church
locations.summary: Rose Church is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: An old church on an island in Liurnia of the Lakes, south of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The church is flooded with blood, and organic-looking growths cover the walls. A Sanguine Noble will materialise upon entering the church.

locations.name: Royal Grave Evergaol
locations.summary: Royal Grave Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol near the graveyard to the east of Caria Manor. An Onyx Lord is interred within.

locations.name: Ruin-Strewn Precipice
locations.summary: Ruin-Strewn Precipice is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A series of caves winding up the cliffs, joining Liurnia to the Altus Plateau. This dungeon can be used as an alternative route to the Grand Lift of Dectus in order to access Altus.

The lower levels of the dungeon consist of a series of mineshafts, illuminated by crystals, housing glintstone miners and Vulgar Militiamen. Higher up, the caves give way to an exposed portion of the cliff face, displaying seemingly-ancient architecture.
A Magma Wyrm dwells in the highest cavern, which also contains a lift to Altus Plateau.
npcs: Great Horned Tragoth (co-operator vs Magma Wyrm Makar)
Blackguard Big Boggart (co-operator vs Magma Wyrm Makar)
notable_loot: Magma Wyrm's Scalesword (Obtained from Magma Wyrm Makar)
Dragon Heart (Obtained from Magma Wyrm Makar)

locations.name: Seluvis's Rise
locations.summary: Seluvis's Rise is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The southernmost tower in the Three Sisters, beyond the Caria Manor. This tower is home to Ranni the Witch's advisor Seluvis who, unbeknownst to the princess, is plotting to turn her into his own puppet.

locations.name: Slumbering Wolf's Shack
locations.summary: Slumbering Wolf's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A shack built on a small plateau jutting from the southern cliffs of Liurnia, accessible via the Lakeside Crystal Cave. Latenna, an Albinauric woman, has taken up residence here with her wolf, Lobo.
sites_of_grace: Accessed through a tunnel found behind the Lakeside Crystal Cave boss room.

locations.name: Stillwater Cave
locations.summary: Stillwater Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A stagnant cave full of poison, inhabited by rot worshipping sorcerers and poisonous Miranda Flowers. At the far end of the system lurks a straggler from Malenia's army.

locations.name: Temple Quarter
locations.summary: Temple Quarter is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined temple complex half-sunken in the lake, south-west of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Just north of the ruins is a small island where a Glintstone Dragon can be found slumbering.

locations.name: Testu's Rise
locations.summary: Testu's Rise is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sorcerer's rise on a small island north of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The tower is sealed, with a statue at the front bearing a note that reads "Seek three wise beasts". To gain entry, the player must find and hit three spectral turtles nearby. The first is north of the tower. The second is up a tree to the east of the tower. The third is south-east of the tower, at the bottom of a rocky outcropping.

locations.name: The Four Belfries
locations.summary: The Four Belfries is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: The Four Belfries sit atop a hill in western Liurnia of the Lakes, north of the Minor Erdtree and south of Caria Manor. Three of the belfries host Sending Gates which will allow access to remote regions of the Lands Between, and must be unlocked using Imbued Sword Keys. One such key can be found in a treasure chest at the foot of the northernmost belfry.
A sign is posted outside each sending gate, teasing its destination. The sending gates lead to these locations:

Chapel of Anticipation ("Precipice of Anticipation"): The area where the game began. The player may return to defeat the Grafted Scion if they did not at the start, as well as obtain The Stormhawk King and Stormhawk Deenh.
Crumbling Farum Azula ("Crumbling Lands"): An isolated section of Farum Azula, where the player may obtain a Pearldrake Talisman.
Siofra River ("Night Sky Unceasing"): A cliff overlooking Nokron, Eternal City. The player may fight a Crucible Knight and find a Mottled Necklace.
notes: The bearded man depicted with branches may be the same figure represented in statue form clutching a tablet in the ruins associated with the Ancient Dynasty.
→ It may also be the old man found in the stone coffins.
It is unconfirmed whether these belfries were rung to beckon spirits in a manner similar to Wandering Mausoleums, Spirit Calling Bell, Spiritcaller Snail, and Wraith Calling Bell.

locations.name: Three Sisters
locations.summary: Three Sisters is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A region on Caria Manor's grounds, only accessible by traversing the manor and defeating Royal Knight Loretta. The area consists of three towers and a smattering of ruined buildings. It is here that Lunar Princess Ranni and her vassals have gathered. Ranni's Rise is the residence of the Carian princess, guarded by Glintstone Dragon Adula. Seluvis's Rise is the home of Ranni's advisor Seluvis. The final tower, Renna's Rise, is initially sealed, however it later provides access to Ainsel River by way of a sending gate.
An illusory floor in a cluster of ruins north-east of Ranni's Rise hides a cellar in which Seluvis stores his puppets.
notable_loot: Ash of War: Chilling Mist (dropped by a scarab)

locations.name: Uld Palace Ruins
locations.summary: Location is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A labyrinth of ancient dynastic ruins in the northeastern region of Liurnia of the Lakes, dotted with broken statues and columns. Ancestral Followers inhabit the ruined palace, while two Walking Mausoleums occupy the northern edge in the Mausoleum Compound.
These remains are located above the Uhl Palace Ruins.

locations.name: Village of the Albinaurics
locations.summary: Village of the Albinaurics is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A secluded Albinauric settlement built into the cliffs beneath a plateau in Liurnia. The village has been ransacked by minions of Sir Gideon Ofnir, the All-Knowing, in search of a medallion which will open the path to Miquella's Haligtree. The surviving Albinaurics have lost their senses, and will attack when approached.

locations.name: Consecrated Snowfield
locations.summary: Consecrated Snowfield is a sub-region located in Mountaintops of the Giants.
overview: A snow-swept, misty area to the west of the Mountaintops of the Giants. The Consecrated Snowfield is final trial for those who seek Miquella's Haligtree, and can only be accessed by uniting the two halves of the Haligtree Secret Medallion, found in the Village of the Albinaurics and Castle Sol, and bringing them to the Grand Lift of Rold.

Visibility is limited in many parts of the snowfield. Small, golden lights illuminate the path from the upper section to the broad, snowy plane below, through which a frozen river runs. In the south-west are the Yelough Anix Ruins, consumed by the Flame of Frenzy. Far to the north lies the Apostate Derelict, where the gentle yet towering sister of Latenna the Albinauric resides. South-east of there is Ordina, Liturgical Town, which hides the entrance to the Haligtree. There is also a waygate, tucked away on the western cliffs, which leads to Mohgwyn Palace.

locations.name: First Church of Marika
locations.summary: First Church of Marika is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A church in eastern Mountaintops of the Giants, south of the frozen lake. This is the site of Queen Marika's address to Godfrey and his men, when she commanded him to put the Fire Giants to the sword, ushering the start of her age.

locations.name: Flame Peak
locations.summary: Flame Peak is a sub-region located in Mountaintops of the Giants.
overview: A region encompassing the southern section of the Mountaintops of the Giants. Flame Peak was the site of the War Against the Giants, and the bodies of the Giants still litter the area. The Forge of the Giants, in the south-east, is where the flame of ruin was confined after the Giants were defeated.

locations.name: Forbidden Lands
locations.summary: Forbidden Lands is a sub-region located in Mountaintops of the Giants.
overview: A dark, frigid stretch of land to the east of Leyndell, Royal Capital, which serves as a route to the Grand Lift of Rold and the northern Mountaintops of the Giants. This area only becomes accessible with the defeat of Morgott, the Omen King, when the player begins their journey to set the Erdtree aflame with Melina.
The area is teeming with Vulgar Militiamen, and a Black Blade Kindred awaits at the entrance to the Grand Lift of Rold.
sites_of_grace: Divine Tower of East Altus: Gate

locations.name: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs
locations.summary: Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A vast, labyrinthine grave in the southern Mountaintops of the Giants, south of the narrow bridge leading to the northern area of the region. The catacombs consist of multiple levels, with several nearly identical rooms and hallways, as well as floors only accessible by dropping down lift shafts.
notable_loot: Golden Seed (dropped by Ulcerated Tree Spirit)
Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing 2 (dropped by Ulcerated Tree Spirit)

locations.name: Grand Lift of Rold
locations.summary: Grand Lift of Rold is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A Grand Lift that links the Forbidden Lands east of Leyndell to the frigid Mountaintops of the Giants. It can only be activated using the Rold Medallion granted by Melina after defeating Morgott, the Omen King.

The Grand Lift of Rold also has another purpose: granting access to the Consecrated Snowfield, the land of Miquella's Haligtree. This region can only be accessed by uniting the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right), obtained in the Village of the Albinaurics, and the Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left), found in Castle Sol. By using this route, the lift will stop at the Hidden Path to the Haligtree, a catacomb which opens onto the Consecrated Snowfield.

locations.name: Guardians' Garrison
locations.summary: Guardians' Garrison is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A fortress occupied by Fire Monks, thorn sorcerers, and Flame Guardians, located on the eastern side of the Mountaintops of the Giants. Arghanthy, the chief guardian, is headquartered here- he can be found on the upper parapet, accessible via a hidden walkway which can be found by breaking some boxes and dropping down from a broken part of the wall.

locations.name: Heretical Rise
locations.summary: Heretical Rise is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A sorcerer's rise west of the frozen lake in eastern Mountaintops of the Giants. The entrance is sealed, but a nearby imp statue holds a sign that reads "Falling snow marks something unseen". The tower is accessed via an invisible walkway, which begins at a broken bridge south-west of the Freezing Lake Site of Grace. Shortly before reaching the tower, the invisible walkway bends to the east and goes upwards.
After entering, the seal on the main entrance will disappear.

locations.name: Lord Contender's Evergaol
locations.summary: Lord Contender's Evergaol is an Evergaol in Elden Ring.
overview: An Evergaol south of the frozen lake in the Mountaintops of the Giants. It is the prison of Vyke, a Tarnished of Roundtable Hold who came close to becoming Elden Lord, but was scorched by the Flame of Frenzy in the depths below Leyndell.
notable_loot: Vyke's Dragonbolt (dropped by Roundtable Knight Vyke)
Fingerprint Set (dropped by Roundtable Knight Vyke)

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (Mountaintops of the Giants)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (Mountaintops of the Giants) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A dead Minor Erdtree in central Mountaintops of the Giants, little more than a stump. It is guarded by an Erdtree Avatar which will duplicate itself during the fight.

locations.name: Shack of the Lofty
locations.summary: Shack of the Lofty is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A small shack north-west of the Stargazers' Ruins in Mountaintops of the Giants. Juno Hoslow, brother of Knight Diallos can be invaded using a red summon sign here.
npcs: Juno Hoslow, Knight of Blood (Volcano Manor target)

locations.name: Spiritcaller Cave
locations.summary: Spiritcaller Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A mysterious cave on the western banks of the frozen lake to the east of the Mountaintops of the Giants. The cave is inhabited by various spirits, summoned by Spiritcaller Snails. The snails are often well hidden, but killing them will cause their summoned spirits to vanish.
bosses: Spiritcaller Snail (summons Godskin Apostle followed by Godskin Noble before exposing itself)
notable_loot: Godskin Swaddling Cloth (dropped by Spiritcaller Snail)
Black Flame Ritual (dropped by Spiritcaller Snail)

locations.name: Stargazer's Ruins
locations.summary: Stargazer's Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined settlement in the western Mountaintops of the Giants, seemingly once inhabited by ancient astrologers. The spirit of a young girl can be found here, awaiting the return of her sister.

locations.name: Zamor Ruins
locations.summary: Zamor Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A settlement in the south-western area of the Mountaintops of the Giants. The Zamor Ruins are inhabited by the Zamor knights, who once challenged the Fire Giants.

locations.name: Corpse-Stench Shack
locations.summary: Corpse-Stench Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A shack at the base of Mt. Gelmir, to the north-east. It stands on the far end of a ruined encampment patrolled by Iron Virgins, in a valley lined with strung-up bodies of humans and trolls alike. Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater invades just outside the shack.
notable_loot: Furlcalling Finger Remedy (dropped by Anastasia, Tarnished-Eater)

locations.name: Craftsman's Shack
locations.summary: Craftsman's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A collection of shacks on the south side of Mt. Gelmir. A crossbow crafted by a genius craftsman who studied Golden Order Fundamentalism can be found here.

locations.name: Fort Laiedd
locations.summary: Fort Laiedd is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A fort on the north-western side of Mt. Gelmir. Fire Monks and Guilty are engaged in combat against Leyndell's forces here, while a Prelate awaits inside. On the top level of the fort, a voice stemming from a Stranded Soul can be heard.
notable_loot: Prelate's Inferno Crozier (dropped by Fire Prelate)

locations.name: Gelmir Hero's Grave
locations.summary: Gelmir Hero's Grave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A Hero's Grave built onto the cliffs of Mt. Gelmir. Much of the grave is flooded with lava, and chariots patrol the wide hallways.
notable_loot: Bloodhound Knight Floh (dropped by Red Wolf of the Champion)

locations.name: Hermit Village
locations.summary: Hermit Village is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: An isolated village on the south-eastern side of Mt. Gelmir. The inhabitants are a mixture of Demi-Humans, and sorcerers from the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Azur, one of the founding Glintstone Sorcerers, settled here after his exile.
notable_loot: Comet Azur (given by Primeval Sorcerer Azur)
Memory Stone (dropped by Demi-Human Queen Maggie)

locations.name: Hermit's Shack
locations.summary: Hermit's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A derelict shack on the south-west side of Mt. Gelmir. The shack has been overtaken by Demi-Humans, and a Runebear lurks nearby. The Runebear can destroy a nearby statue to obtain Smithing Stones.

locations.name: Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir)
locations.summary: Minor Erdtree (Mt. Gelmir) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A burnt, shrivelled Minor Erdtree on the north-eastern side of Mt. Gelmir, found at the site of a battle between Leyndell's army and the forces of Praetor Rykard. The corpses of humans and trolls have been hung from poles all along the path leading to the Minor Erdtree, which is guarded by a Tree Spirit.
notable_loot: Leaden Hardtear (dropped by Ulcerated Tree Spirit)
Cerulean Hidden Tear (dropped by Ulcerated Tree Spirit)

locations.name: Seethewater Cave
locations.summary: Seethewater Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A poison-flooded cave on the north-eastern side of Mt. Gelmir. The cave is occupied by worshipers of poison and rot.

locations.name: Subterranean Inquisition Chamber
locations.summary: Subterranean Inquisition Chamber is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A network of lava-flooded caves within the grounds of the Volcano Manor. The cave cannot be conventionally accessed: instead one must be abducted by the Iron Virgin in the cave at the bottom of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Once the player enters the cave, it is impossible to warp out until they have defeated the boss and found the exit, which opens out onto Mt. Gelmir. It is also possible to access the cave from Volcano Manor itself, by dropping down a series of platforms near the Temple of Eiglay.

locations.name: Volcano Cave
locations.summary: Volcano Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A cave on the northern side of Mt. Gelmir, which serves as a refuge for a group of Demi-Humans.
notable_loot: Jar Cannon (dropped by Demi-Human Chief Margot)

locations.name: Wyndham Catacombs
locations.summary: Wyndham Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: Catacombs built at the base of the eastern side of Mt. Gelmir. The dungeon is full of lightning-based traps and enemies, and contains a flooded lower level occupied by Putrid Corpses.

locations.name: Night's Sacred Ground
locations.summary: Night's Sacred Ground is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A district within Nokron, Eternal City, accessed by traversing the rooftops south of the Ancestral Woods Site of Grace. A large cathedral-like building can be entered via a window, by climbing across the top of a large gate. The Mimic Tear Ashes can be obtained from a chest behind a door that requires a Stonesword Key to open.

On the lower level is a long street populated by Silver Tears and Mimic Tears, one of which transforms into a Troll. The secret treasure of Nokron, the Fingerslayer Blade, is found below a chair-crypt that props up a vast corpse.

locations.name: Siofra Aqueduct
locations.summary: Siofra Aqueduct is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A vast aqueduct accessed by traversing a series of walkways between spires that hand from the ceiling of the Siofra River. The area is patrolled by two Crucible Knights, as well as a platoon of Fallen Hawk Soldiers. Within a cave at the northern end of the aqueduct is a coffin which acts as a transporter to Deeproot Depths, but it is guarded by a pair of Valiant Gargoyles.
npcs: D, Beholder of Death (can also be summoned as a cooperator vs Valiant Gargoyles after giving him the Twinned Set)

locations.name: Hallowhorn Grounds (North)
locations.summary: Hallowhorn Grounds (North) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined structure built by the ancient dynasty on the upper level of Siofra River, north of Nokron, Eternal City. Its counterpart is the Hallowhorn Grounds (South).

After lighting the flames on six obelisks scattered around the area, the body of the horned creature in the structure will begin to glow. Touching it will lead to an encounter with the Regal Ancestor Spirit.
notable_loot: Remembrance of the Regal Ancestor (dropped by Regal Ancestor Spirit)

locations.name: Hallowhorn Grounds (South)
locations.summary: Hallowhorn Grounds (South) is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined ancient dynasty structure on the southeastern edge of Siofra River. At the far end of the structure is the body of a horned creature, which cannot be interacted with initially. However, by lighting eight flames in pillars scattered around the area, the body will begin to glow. Touching the remains will lead to an encounter with the Ancestor Spirit. The Hallowhorn Grounds (North) is the counterpart to this area.
notable_loot: Ancestral Follower Ashes (dropped by Ancestor Spirit)

locations.name: Ailing Village
locations.summary: Ailing Village is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A small settlement on the Weeping Peninsula, due north of Castle Morne. The inhabitants have been driven mad by the Frenzied Flame, and are gathered around a pyre in the centre of the village. Callu Baptismal Church rests at the southern end of the village.

locations.name: Bridge of Sacrifice
locations.summary: Bridge of Sacrifice is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A short, heavily fortified bridge connecting mainland Limgrave to the Weeping Peninsula to the south. It is guarded by a number of soldiers, one of which is manning a ballista.

locations.name: Church of Pilgrimage
locations.summary: Church of Pilgrimage is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A crumbling church on the northernmost point of the Weeping Peninsula. When resting at the Site of Grace, Melina offers to share echoes of Queen Marika the Eternal, vowing to return what she claimed to Godfrey, First Elden Lord and his warriors. A Stranded Soul sits outside the entrance to the church, muttering about the nearby Walking Mausoleum which cradles a soulless Demigod, the unwanted child of Queen Marika.

locations.name: Earthbore Cave
locations.summary: Earthbore Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A small dark cave to the north of the Weeping Peninsula. A pack of rats has made its nest here. A chest can be found just beyond the Site of Grace, however the ground in front of it is weak and will give way when stepped on.

locations.name: Fourth Church of Marika
locations.summary: Fourth Church of Marika is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A church on a hill in the western region of Weeping Peninsula. Several Mausoleum Soldiers guard the church, which houses a Sacred Tear.

locations.name: Impaler's Catacombs
locations.summary: Impaler's Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: These catacombs are located on the north-eastern coast of the Weeping Peninsula. They are inhabited by imps, and fortified with rising platforms that will push the player into the spiked ceiling.
notable_loot: Demi-Human Ashes (obtained from Erdtree Burial Watchdog)

locations.name: Isolated Merchant's Shack (Weeping Peninsula)
locations.summary: Isolated Merchant's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A shack on the western coast of Weeping Peninsula, inhabited by a lone merchant.

locations.name: Tombsward Catacombs
locations.summary: Tombsward Catacombs is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: Catacombs north of the Minor Erdtree in Weeping Peninsula. Fire-spewing pillars are positioned throughout the dungeon, although they can be lowered by striking them, disabling them and offering the ability to use them as raising platforms.
notable_loot: Lhutel the Headless (obtained from Cemetery Shade)

locations.name: Tombsward Cave
locations.summary: Tombsward Cave is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A cave drenched in poison and teeming with vermin. Sorcerers adorned in fungal garb dwell here, along with a pack of rats, and poison-spewing Miranda sprouts.
notable_loot: Viridian Amber Medallion (obtained from Miranda the Blighted Bloom)

locations.name: Tombsward Ruins
locations.summary: Tombsward Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined structure in the north-eastern region of the Weeping Peninsula. Two pages, armed with crossbows, dwell within the cellar.

locations.name: Tower of Return
locations.summary: Tower of Return is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A dilapidated watchtower occupied by Godrick's forces. A treasure chest at the top is enchanted with a spell which will teleport the player to Leyndell, Royal Capital, to fight a Guardian Golem and retrieve a Blessed Dew Talisman.

locations.name: Witchbane Ruins
locations.summary: Witchbane Ruins is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A ruined structure just south of the Fourth Church of Marika on the Weeping Peninsula, in the middle of a poison pool. Several marionettes and a Graven Mass protect a cellar, where an apostate witch is held prisoner.
npcs: Castellan Jerren (after taking Sellen's Primal Glintstone)

locations.name: Morne Tunnel
locations.summary: Morne Tunnel is a dungeon in Elden Ring.
overview: A mining gallery in the center of the Weeping Peninsula, east of the Minor Erdtree. Much like Castle Morne to its southeast, these mines have been overrun by Misbegotten. The Scaly Misbegotten waits for explorers at the end of the tunnel.
The Morne Tunnel Site of Grace is found at the bottom of the lift at the tunnel's entrance.

locations.name: Scadu Altus
locations.summary: Scadu Altus Shadow of the Erdtree is a region in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: A plateau in the center of the Realm of Shadow, occupied by the army of Messmer the Impaler. It was named for its counterpart in the realm of the Erdtree. Messmer's stronghold, the Shadow Keep, lies to the north of the region. In the eastern half of the plateau, the Recluses' River flows from the Castle Watering Hole and empties into the forbidden Abyssal Woods. The Ruins of Unte, the Village of Flies, and Bonny Village can be found along the Recluses' River. Just outside Castle Ensis, the Moorth Highway branches off from the Highroad, running south through the Moorth Ruins and leading to the Fort of Reprimand.

Like its neighbor to the south in the Gravesite Plain, the Scadu Altus is primarily vegetated by spiritgrave grass, which grows from the berry-like Rada Fruit. There are also a few small forests in the region, including the Bear Woods located to the east of the highway junction.

The sky above the Scadu Altus often emits a yellow-green light. Cinders and sparks can be seen in the air; embers of Messmer, symbols of the crusade, can be harvested as they slither across the ground.
[Accessing Scadu Altus]
Scadu Altus has two points of access:
After defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight at Castle Ensis, the exit from the Ensis Moongazing Grounds leads to the plateau.
A spiritspring jump near the Elder's Hovel in the eastern Gravesite Plain can be used to access the Fort of Reprimand. Exiting the fort leads to Scadu Altus proper.

locations.name: Gate of Divinity
locations.summary: Gate of Divinity is a mysterious place atop of Enir-Ilim that seemingly allows ascension to godhood. It is a location in Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: The Gate of Divinity has seemingly existed since time immemorial.

Before the Age of the Erdtree, an Empyrean and Numen woman hailing from the Shaman Village named Marika traveled to the Gate and ascended to godhood. There she became the vessel of the Elden Ring. Her ascension led to the creation of the Erdtree and the Scadutree and ushered in a new era, with Marika becoming sovereign of the Lands Between and Godfrey becoming her spouse and the first Elden Lord.

Following the death of Mohg, Lord of Blood, his corpse was stolen and transported to the Land of Shadow where Miquella would require it for an ancient ritual. At the Gate of Divinity Miquella ascended to godhood and resurrected Radahn, using the body of Mogh as a vessel. Miquella then blessed Radahn and made him his consort. The Tarnished then defeats Radahn and Miquella, preventing the latter's "Age of Compassion".
notes: If struck with a weapon, the Gate of Divinity bleeds.
The Gate appears to have ropes on it.

locations.name: Castle Ensis
locations.summary: Castle Ensis Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon on the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A looming castle to the north of the Gravesite Plain, across the Ellac Greatbridge from the main expanse. To the castle's west is Fog Rift, and to its north is Scadu Altus which can be reached from the Ensis Moongazing Grounds after defeating the castle's main boss.
Ensis is the estate of Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, overseen by the chamberlain Moonrithyll. The estate's entrance is guarded by a Carian Troll Knight, a friend of Moonrithyll.

Rellana, younger sister to Rennala, was a Carian princess before she disavowed her heritage to stand by the side of Messmer and his crusade. A warcamp of Messmer's soldiers and Black Knights sits at the base of Castle Ensis and there are additional Black Knights stationed throughout the estate.
Miquella abandoned a piece of the flesh of his body here along his quest, creating a Cross of Miquella.
notable_loot: Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight
