locations.summary: Ancient Ruins of Rauh Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region of the Land of the Tower.
sites_of_grace: Church of the Bud, Main Entrance
npcs: Dryleaf Dane (Romina, Saint of the Bud)
notable_loot: Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud
Stone-Sheathed Sword / Sword of Darkness / Sword of Light

locations.name: Belurat, Tower Settlement
locations.summary: Belurat, Tower Settlement Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region and dungeon in the Land of the Tower, to the west of Gravesite Plain.
overview: A Hornsent city at the base of a shaded tower, to the northwest of the Gravesite Plain. The Gate of Divinity is said to reside somewhere here. Belurat was besieged during the Crusade of Messmer the Impaler.

Belurat was once the location of the tower festival, during which the sculpted keepers would perform the dance of the Divine Beast. After Messmer's forces assailed the city, the sculpted keepers became warriors and the Divine Beasts were weaponized in the city's defense.

The city consists of a ground level, a boggy, infested lower city, and an upper city and rooftop segment. It is accessed for the first time by heading northwest from the Main Gate Cross Site of Grace in the Gravesite Plain. From there, a large entry stairway leads to towering doors marking the city entrance.
Later on in the story of Shadow of the Erdtree, a second entrance to Belurat can be opened by descending Enir-Ilim. This leads to the staircase just outside the Theatre of the Divine Beast.
npcs: Redmane Freyja (summon for the Divine Beast Dancing Lion, only until Miquella's Great Rune is broken)

locations.name: Enir-Ilim
locations.summary: Enir-Ilim Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region and legacy dungeon in the Land of the Tower.
overview: The fabled spiral tower of the Hornsent and the location of the Gate of Divinity, Enir-Ilim pierced the skies with such a majesty that it even inspired a secret faith in the people sent there to destroy it. When the Crusade of Messmer the Impaler took place, the tower was veiled in shadow. As such, Enir-Ilim may only be accessed after using Messmer's Kindling to burn the sealing tree located near the Church of the Bud in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh.
The tower comprises an intricate network of spiral staircases and rises; it is the final area of the Shadow of the Erdtree main quest, armed to the teeth with Horned Warriors and Inquisitors.

After dispelling the shroud cast over Enir-Ilim and journeying downward through the tower, the main door to it can be opened from just outside the Theatre of the Divine Beast in Belurat, Tower Settlement. Enir-Ilim is the "tower" referred to both in Belurat's name and in that of the Tower Festival that took place there.
notable_loot: Remembrance of a God and a Lord
Scadutree Fragment x1 (backtrack to Belurat, Tower Settlement)
Somber Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone x1

locations.name: Abyssal Woods
locations.summary: The Abyssal Woods, also known as the Abyss, is a sub-region of Scadu Altus.
overview: Below the rest of the Realm of Shadow, hidden under a sprawling canopy that blots out the light of the sky, a thick swampy woodland corrupted by Madness. Jori, the elder Hornsent Inquisitor, guards the entrance to the area at the end of the Darklight Catacombs.

The forest is forbidden by the Hornsent, as is the frenzied flame contained within. The woods are so harrowing that even Torrent refuses to be summoned out of fear. Messages on the ground warn about beings lurking in the woods, creatures that cannot be touched and can kill one with a glance.
In the heart of the woods sits the ruined manse of Sage Midra.
The Abyssal Woods can only be accessed by navigating through the Darklight Catacombs at the terminus of the Recluses' River.
[Messages Left in the Woods]
A series of messages has been left in the forest, along the path to Midra's Manse.

locations.name: Midra's Manse
locations.summary: Midra's Manse is a minor legacy dungeon in the Abyssal Woods Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: A decaying manor hidden in the southern reaches of the forbidden Abyssal Woods and home to Sage Midra. The only way to access Midra's Manse is via traversing the madness-infested, swampy woodland.

Once a vibrant house surrounded by flowers, the manor has fallen into disrepair after the emergence of the Flame of Frenzy. The house is strewn with charred books, furniture is broken and overturned, and the tapestries are shredded and ragged.
notable_loot: Remembrance of the Lord of Frenzied Flame

locations.name: Shadow Keep, Church District
locations.summary: Shadow Keep, Church District is a sub-section of the Shadow Keep.

locations.name: Specimen Storehouse
locations.summary: The Specimen Storehouse is a sub-section of the Shadow Keep.
overview: The tallest tower in the keep of Messmer the Impaler, stacked with floors upon floors of stone tablets, scrolls, and specimens of unknown lifeforms. The storehouse is teeming with Messmer's Fire Knights, and the spirit ashes of Fire Knight Hilde have been enshrined as a charm to protect it.

locations.name: Abandoned Church
locations.summary: The Abandoned Church Shadow of the Erdtree is a location in the Abyssal Woods.
overview: A derelict church in the forbidden woods of the abyss. It serves as a checkpoint along the woodland trail to Midra's Manse.
The nearest site of grace is Church Ruins, located just inside the building.
notable_loot: Map: Abyss, found on a stele just outside the church entrance.

locations.name: Church of the Bud
locations.summary: The Church of the Bud is a location in Elden Ring. It is located in the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. Shadow of the Erdtree
overview: Within the giant ruins that are flooded and overgrown lies the Church of the Bud, overlooking the tower of shadow. Once, in the crumbling, burning church, Romina held the bud in speechless silence. That bud would become her blade. The scarlet butterflies are as the Goddess of Rot's wings. Bereft of a master, they were soothed by Romina, who reached out to them. While once smaller in size, recent giant Spider Scorpions are said to trace back to the Church of the Bud. The pests are abandoned servants, and it is for this reason that they found a mother in the Saint of the Bud. There was a time when the scarlet buds were not touched by the rot's blight — when they were the symbol of the small church deep in the ancient ruins of Rauh. Now they are large, rotten and will never come into bloom, indicative of how rot eats away at life like a vicious plague. Just beyond the church lies the sealing tree which requires special kindling to be burned. Doing so grants access to Enir-Ilim and further progresses the DLC.
sites_of_grace: Church of the Bud, Main Entrance

locations.name: Abandoned Ailing Village
locations.summary: Abandoned Ailing Village Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Gravesite Plain.

locations.name: Artist's Shack (Gravesite Plain)
locations.summary: The Artist's Shack is a location on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: A run-down hovel located high on the plateau on the southwestern Gravesite Plain. The artist left a painting here titled "Incursion", depicting the final moments of one who passed away.

The shack can be accessed by heading southeast from Prospect Town. The nearest Site of Grace in terms of on-foot distance is Cliffroad Terminus; although Gravesite Plain is spatially closer, it is far below.
This Artist's Shack is the only one of its kind in the Realm of Shadow.

locations.name: Belurat Gaol
locations.summary: Belurat Gaol Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon on the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A frigid gaol under the Hornsent city of Belurat. Located due west of the Abandoned Ailing Village on the Gravesite Plain. In this gaol, the condemned were diced up and stuffed into jars. The prisoners in the gaol are sustained by frozen maggots that grow in the jar innards.
Deep within the gaol, Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze has imprisoned himself to stall the ruinous conclusion he foresaw on his path.

Like the other gaols in the realm of shadow, the Belurat Gaol is populated by Jar Dwellers and Shadow Undead. A Stranded Soul outside a shaft of hanging jars begs forgiveness, promising they "won't ever do it again." It is not known what crimes one had to commit to be condemned to the jars.

The Belurat Gaol is a suitable location to stock up on frozen maggots, which are used to craft the Hefty Freezing Pot. Additionally, Innard Meat can be harvested from the Jar Dwellers; this tool can be thrown to weaponize its rancorous spirits.
notable_loot: Demi-Human Swordsman Yosh (obtained from Demi-Human Swordmaster Onze)

locations.name: Cerulean Coast
locations.summary: The Cerulean Coast Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region of the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A coastal plain of cerulean flowers and mist on the Southern Shore of the Realm of Shadow. Accessible by following the Ellac River downstream. The Cerulean Coast is adorned with massive stone coffins resembling ships. The region has ties to the traditions of the Lands Between from before the Age of the Erdtree regarding death; many of the roads in the Cerulean Coast are lined by spirit worms and jellyfish, and a ghostflame dragon can be found not far from the entrance to the area.

The Cerulean Coast is bordered by Charo's Hidden Grave, the Foot of the Jagged Peak, and the Abyssal Woods to its north. The southern peninsula of the coast is split by a ravine leading to the Stone Coffin Fissure.

locations.name: Charo's Hidden Grave
locations.summary: Charo's Hidden Grave Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region of the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A field of crimson lilies nestled between the Cerulean Coast and the southern Gravesite Plain, and the resting place of Charo. It is said a rare gravesite flower blossoms here into the cold ghostflame. The silent ghostflame blooms that grow here are barely tangible, and are sisters to the spirit-calling grave violets.

Charo's Hidden Grave can be reached by heading west-southwest from the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion at the Foot of the Jagged Peak. This area is only accessible after traversing the Dragon's Pit and defeating the Ancient Dragon-Man.
The wizened Tibia Mariners, first of all grave keepers were interred amidst the crimson sea of lilies. It is said their ancient skulls are still imbued with the power to summon the dead.

locations.name: Church of Benediction
locations.summary: The Church of Benediction is a location on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: An abandoned church on the southwestern Gravesite Plain. The Church of Benediction is located directly above where the Tarnished first emerges into the Realm of Shadow, but it is only accessible by taking the cliffroad south of Belurat, Tower Settlement up onto the plateau.
A talisman was left here depicting blue sap from the Erdtree. Nearby is a discarded set of armor from the Oathseeker Knights, along with one of their weapons of choice, the pata.

locations.name: Church of Consolation
locations.summary: The Church of Benediction is a location on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: An abandoned church on the southeastern Gravesite Plain. The Church of Consolation is located at the end of the road heading southeast from the Scorched Ruins, beyond the woods where Logur, the Beast Claw resides.

The area is slowly being flooded by a waterfall, and the floor of the church is covered in water reaching knee-height. Inside, a Black Knight of Messmer the Impaler wields the Black Steel Greathammer, imbued with the power of the Erdtree's blessing. Two Scadutree Fragments are found within the church, serving as a prayer.
The nearest Site of Grace is Gravesite Plain. Heading due east from this site and then following the road leads directly to the church.

locations.name: Dragon's Pit
locations.summary: Dragon's Pit Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon on the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A cave at the end of the Pillar-Path on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow. The Dragon's Pit is the path to the Foot of the Jagged Peak. It can be accessed by bearing south-southwest at the Pillar Path Waypoint site of grace.

As indicated by its name, the dungeon is dragon-themed, full of skeletons of Farum Azula beastmen and ritual implements of Dragon Communion. A Magma Wyrm prowls one of the cavern's upper chambers, and deep in the belly of a chasm the Ancient Dragon-Man awaits one worthy to face the Dread Dragon.

Information about the Ancient Dragon-Man indicates that the Dragon's Pit might have served as a rite of passage for Dragon Communion practitioners who sought to slay the Dread Dragon. The means by which the Ancient Dragon-Man assumed his form was the original form of Dragon Communion.

locations.name: Elder's Hovel
locations.summary: The Elder's Hovel is a location on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: A burnt, ruined shack southeast of the Fort of Reprimand. The Elder's Hovel sits in the shadow of the cliffside beneath the fort. It can be found via the festering swamp southeast of the crossroads at the military encampment outside Castle Ensis.

Little other information about the house remains, but the Talisman of the Dread can be found here, a relic depicting the dread dragon of the nearby Jagged Peak. The Elder's Hovel overlooks the mountain itself as well as its foothills.
A Stranded Soul in the hovel appears to be praying to the dread dragon, asking that he channel his rage and aching pain to destroy the "arrogant lot," likely referring to the Ancient Dragons.

locations.name: Ellac Greatbridge
locations.summary: The Ellac Greatbridge is a landmark on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: A massive bridge spanning the canyon carved by the Ellac River on the northern Gravesite Plain. The Ellac Greatbridge connects Castle Ensis and the military encampment at its foot to the road leading to Belurat, Tower Settlement. The bridge is heavily fortified by Messmer Soldiers.
The nearest Sites of Grace are Three-Path Cross for northbound travelers, and Castle Front at Castle Ensis for southbound travelers.

locations.name: Finger Ruins of Rhia
locations.summary: The Finger Ruins of Rhia Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Cerulean Coast in Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: A hallowed ruin of fingers, the first of three encountered in Count Ymir's questline. Only those with a fate sanctioned by the stars may ring the bell at the center, which advances the questline and grants the Crimson Seed Talisman +1.

The mysterious ruins consist of a vast stone plain with a fingerprint-like topography. Massive finger-shaped obelisks point inwards toward the hanging bell. A Remembrance Duplication Coffin can be found near the southeastern corner of the ruins.
The nearest Site of Grace is Finger Ruins of Rhia, found just beyond the entry of the ruins (see below.)
[Access]

The Finger Ruins of Rhia can be found by following the southern shoreline of the Cerulean Coast to the east, eventually leading to a stone coffin ship. Climbing up this ship leads to a precipice overlooking the ruins.

locations.name: Finger-Weaver's Hovel
locations.summary: The Finger-Weaver's Hovel Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Cerulean Coast.
overview: A run-down cabin on the eastern end of the Cerulean Coast of the Gravesite Plain.
A maddened student of the Finger Ruins left a record of crafting techniques here. Acquiring this record allows one to craft the Glinting Nail, an imitation of the lampreys' sorcery.

locations.name: Fog Rift Catacombs
locations.summary: Fog Rift Catacombs Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon on the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A secluded, treacherous tomb in the Fog Rift of the northern Gravesite Plain. The catacombs are directly north of Fog Rift Fort.

Like the other catacombs in the Realm of Shadow, these pose unique threats with phenomena not seen in the Lands Between. At the end of the catacombs, a Death Knight wielding Death Knight's Twin Axes stands guard over the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate. This Death Knight was one of Godwyn's personal guards.
notable_loot: Death Knight's Twin Axes (from Death Knight)

locations.name: Fog Rift Fort
locations.summary: Fog Rift Fort is a fort on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: A black fortress looming over the road leading to Fog Rift. Soldiers of Messmer's army are stationed on bridges across the valley, armed with Fire Pots. The building is located just across the moat of Castle Ensis.
Inside the fort is Black Knight Garrew, a warrior of iron conviction.
[Access]

Despite being located within the Gravesite Plain, the Fog Rift Fort can only be accessed by dropping down from above from the southwestern Scadu Altus. As such, the nearest Site of Grace is Scadu Altus, West.

locations.name: Foot of the Jagged Peak
locations.summary: The Foot of the Jagged Peak Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region of the Gravesite Plain.
overview: The craggy foothills of the Jagged Peak. The Foot of the Jagged Peak is reached through the Dragon's Pit after slaying the Ancient Dragon-Man and passing through the Dragon's Pit Terminus. Nearby is the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion, where the Dragon Communion Priestess explains the purpose and history of Dragon Communion.

locations.name: Grand Altar of Dragon Communion
locations.summary: The Grand Altar of Dragon Communion is a location at the Foot of the Jagged Peak in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: An ancient site of Dragon Communion found in the corpse of a massive drake. The Dragon Communion Priestess dwells here, sacrificing her sleep every night so that Placidusax might take solace in it instead. In turn, she receives her lord's favor, which she can offer as a blessing to the Tarnished.

The Dragon Communion Priestess stands watch over a large bowl surrounded by the neck of the dead drake. In this bowl, the flame of Dragon Communion burns; the Tarnished can interact with it to gain the powers of dragons, much like can be done at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave and the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid.

The Grand Altar of Dragon Communion can be reached by taking the Pillar Path highroad south from Castle Ensis on the Gravesite Plain, then going through the Dragon's Pit to reach the Foot of the Jagged Peak. The Grand Altar is located around a kilometer south from there. The nearest Site of Grace is Grand Altar of Dragon Communion, but if it has not been accessed yet, the next closest is Dragon's Pit Terminus.
The titanic dragon corpse is littered with Dragon Communion Harpoons. Traversing the body and crossing its wings leads to Charo's Hidden Grave.
notable_loot: Ancient Dragon Florissax or Priestess Heart and Flowerstone Gavel, depending on the choices of the Tarnished.
Igon's Cookbook [1], in a ruined watchtower at the north of the altar.
notes: The drake corpse is around four hundred meters long, making it around seventy meters longer than that of Gransax.
→ As a result, this is also the largest known dragon in the world of Elden Ring.
The dead drake has been impaled in the head with a massive harpoon. Additionally, its heart has been carved out; it is possible that the heart was consumed in an act of communion.

locations.name: Jagged Peak
locations.summary: Jagged Peak Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region of the Gravesite Plain.
overview: Visible from the rest of the Realm of Shadow, the great mountain can be seen dominating the skyline. The closer one gets to the mountain, the more dangerous and wild the storms become, and red lightning strikes the steep slopes and sharp stones. The area is home to many powerful dragons and drakes, and their corpses can be seen in great number littering the mountain's sides. At the top is a legendary and feared dragon, whose rage against the Dragonlord remains potent and destructive.

The Jagged Peak can be reached through the Dragon's Pit after slaying the Ancient Dragon-Man and passing through the Dragon's Pit Terminus. In the foothills of the mountain is the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion, where the Dragon Communion Priestess explains the purpose and history of the occult ritual. The corpse of a colossal drake towers over the Grand Altar; walking across its body leads to Charo's Hidden Grave.
notes: The Jagged Peak can be seen from most elevated points in the Realm of Shadow.

locations.name: Lamenter's Gaol
locations.summary: Lamenter's Gaol Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon on the Gravesite Plain in Charo's Hidden Grave.
overview: A frozen gaol deep in Charo's Hidden Grave on the southern shore of the Gravesite Plain. Like other similar locations, the Lamenter's Gaol was a facility where the Hornsent sliced up their condemned and placed their remains into Living Jars to become "saints". The prisoners in the gaol sustain themselves by consuming the frozen maggots that grow in the jars' innards.

The Hornsent sealed the power of the Lamenter in this gaol out of fear for the "true bliss" caused by happy lamentation. The bliss and "languid ease" of those who could no longer see was banished to the depths of the gaol. A Stranded Soul in the gaol is found keeling over, begging for the noise of the lamentation to stop and saying they need no salvation. The Lamenter is the boss of the dungeon.

Like the other gaols in the realm of shadow, the Lamenter's Gaol is populated by Jar Dwellers and Shadow Undead. The Lamenter's Gaol is a suitable location to stock up on frozen maggots, which are used to craft the Hefty Freezing Pot. Additionally, Innard Meat can be harvested from the Jar Dwellers; this tool can be thrown to weaponize its rancorous spirits.

locations.name: Prospect Town
locations.summary: Prospect Town is a ruined township on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: Like most other townships in the Realm of Shadow, Prospect Town was burned and razed. The clan that lived here turned their worship to the Mother of Truth after witnessing her shadow in the corpse of their ancestor. These Hornsent, now Bloodfiends, wield one another's arms as makeshift weapons created with blood rituals.
The nearest Site of Grace is Cliffroad Terminus, located to the north of the township.

locations.name: Rivermouth Cave
locations.summary: Rivermouth Cave Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon on the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A cave at the mouth of the Ellac River home to a tribe of Bloodfiends. It can be accessed by following the Ellac River upstream from the Ellac River Cave site of grace on the eastern Gravesite Plain.

The cave is filled with festering pools of blood, likely from the Mother of Truth. The Bloodfiends that live here are members of a subjugated tribe who discovered the deity and were transformed into the ogre-like creatures. A group of hexers perform bloodboon rituals in the cave with the Bloodfiend's Sacred Spear.

locations.name: Ruined Forge Lava Intake
locations.summary: Ruined Forge Lava Intake Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon on the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A decrepit forge on the eastern Gravesite Plain, strewn with smoldering and ruined weaponry. The entrance is located south-southeast from the Castle Front site of grace at Castle Ensis. The plain in front of the forge is littered with massive ruined columns. Like the other Ruined Forges in the Realm of Shadow, the Ruined Forge Lava intake does not have a boss encounter; to find the ultimate prize of the dungeon requires a little more care.
In ancient times, the smithing that occurred here was a divine act; even the anvil was an altar. Though those times are past, Golem Smiths remain active and lava remains a threat.
The Ruined Forge Lava Intake is a suitable place to harvest Gas Stones. They were likely used as fuel for the forges at one point, but they are now used to craft the Hefty Volcano Pot.

locations.name: Run-Down Traveler's Rest
locations.summary: The Run-Down Traveler's Rest is a location on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: A burnt, ruined shack southeast of the Abandoned Ailing Village. The Run-Down Traveler's Rest sits in the shadow of the Ellac Greatbridge on a cliff overlooking the Ellac River canyon.

Little other information about the house remains, but a petrified corpse sitting against the wall carries the Greater Potentate's Cookbook [2]. This book contains crafting techniques left by a potentate who was haunted by the practice of putting people in jars.

locations.name: Scorched Ruins
locations.summary: Scorched Ruins is a location in the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A charred, ruined town on the main road through the Gravesite Plain. A stranded soul nearby laments how all has been "burned to cinders" by Messmer the Impaler.
The nearest Site of Grace is Scorched Ruins, a short distance to the north of the town.

locations.name: Southern Nameless Mausoleum
locations.summary: The Southern Nameless Mausoleum Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on an island off the Cerulean Coast.
overview: A mausoleum on an island off the Cerulean Coast of the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow. The area outside is populated with crabs. The mausoleum can be accessed from a subterranean cave in the Cerulean Coast that crosses under the water and emerges on the island. Inside the tomb is an arena containing the spirit of the Dancer of Ranah, a warrior engaged in a fiery, endless dance.

The four nameless mausoleums in the Realm of Shadow are home to the spirits of warriors who have lost either their names or their hearts. The Dancer of Ranah has been dancing for so long that she has lost her name.

The nearest site of grace is Cerulean Coast West. The cave is a short walk southeast from there. Repeat attempts can be made as needed by respawning from the Effigy of the Matyr just outside the mausoleum.
notable_loot: Dancer's Set, dropped by the Dancer of Ranah
Dancing Blade of Ranah, dropped by the Dancer of Ranah
Perfumed Oil of Ranah, located just north of the mausoleum's entrance

locations.name: Stone Coffin Fissure
locations.summary: Stone Coffin Fissure Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region of the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A massive underground ravine at the southernmost tip of the Realm of Shadow. The Stone Coffin Fissure is the place to which stone coffins drift. The chasm has taken on a bruised color from the putrescence oozing from the coffins; this putrescence is what remains of the "impure" life stored within each drifting coffin.

It was down this chasm that Miquella discarded his love - and his other half, Saint Trina. At the bottom of the fissure, Trina's nectar-like blood pooled and nectarblood burgeons bloomed, forming the Garden of Deep Purple. In the garden, Trina was left to wither away.
When Sir Moore discovered deep purple water lilies on the southern shore of the Cerulean Coast, Thiollier journeyed south to the fissure in search of Saint Trina.

Some of the congealed putrescence from the stone coffins came into contact with and imbibed the nectar-like blood of Saint Trina, giving rest to the tainted life. This gave rise to the Putrescent Knight that guards Trina's garden.

locations.name: Suppressing Pillar
locations.summary: The Suppressing Pillar is a landmark on the Gravesite Plain in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: A massive, mysterious obelisk towering over the Gravesite Plain. It can be reached via the Pillar Path road, taken south from the military encampment outside Castle Ensis.

An elevator inside the base of the tower leads to a landing on top, offering a full view of the surrounding Realm of Shadow. There is also a box atop the tower containing an Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone.
The message at the Suppressing Pillar reads:
"The very center of the Lands Between. All manners of Death wash up here, only to be suppressed."

locations.name: Western Nameless Mausoleum
locations.summary: The Western Nameless Mausoleum Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Gravesite Plain.
overview: A mausoleum in a corner on the western Gravesite Plain. The area outside is populated with Spirit Eels and Gravebirds. The mausoleum can be accessed soon after entering the Realm of Shadow, with no major obstacles between it and the first site of grace. It is located due west from the site of grace at the Scorched Ruins. Inside is an arena containing the spirit of the Knight of the Solitary Gaol.

The four nameless mausoleums in the Realm of Shadow are home to the spirits of warriors who have lost either their names or their hearts. The Knights of the Solitary Gaol gave up their hearts for enhanced combat prowess.
The nearest sites of grace are Gravesite Plain and Scorched Ruins.

locations.name: Rauh Base
locations.summary: Rauh Base Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region of the Land of the Tower.
overview: A wetland in the canyon formed by the Scorpion River, far below the Ancient Ruins of Rauh. The eastern segment of Rauh Base is crossed by the great bridge between the Western Rampart of Shadow Keep and the Viaduct Minor Tower.
The northwesternmost point of the Realm of Shadow comprises the Bear Woods at Rauh Base's edge, home to Rugalea the Great Red Bear and the nearby Scorpion River Catacombs.

locations.name: Taylew's Ruined Forge
locations.summary: Taylew's Ruined Forge Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon in Rauh Base.
overview: A decrepit forge found in Rauh Base, strewn with smoldering and ruined weaponry. Like the other ruined forges in the Realm of Shadow, the Ruined Forge Lava intake does not have a boss encounter. Taylew the Golem Smith was said to be the runt of the litter and the first to stop moving, but it was he who became the guardian deity of smithery.

locations.name: Temple Town Ruins
locations.summary: Temple Town Ruins is a ruined township at the Rauh Base in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: Like most other townships in the Realm of Shadow, the Temple Town Ruins were burned and razed. The horned warriors such as the one found here were fitting figureheads for the military might of the tower they kept watch over, their deft attacks slashing through any and all foes. By using a nearby spiritspring, one can reach a secret path to the spirit ash of Divine Bird Warrior Ornis. Ornis succeeded in taming the divine bird and made its wings his own as he soared through the sky. When he finally fell to earth, he lived on as the guardian deity of the temple quarter.
The nearest Site of Grace is Temple Town Ruins, located to the north of the township.

locations.name: Scorpion River Catacombs
locations.summary: Scorpion River Catacombs Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon at Rauh Base in the Land of the Tower.
overview: A secluded, treacherous tomb at the end of the Scorpion River of the western Rauh Base. The catacombs are directly west of the Ravine North Site of Grace.

Like the other catacombs in the Realm of Shadow, these pose unique threats with phenomena not seen in the Lands Between. At the end of the catacombs, a Death Knight wielding the Death Knight's Longhaft Axe stands guard over the Prince of Death's cadaver surrogate. This Death Knight was one of Godwyn's personal guards.
notable_loot: Death Knight's Longhaft Axe (from Death Knight)

locations.name: Bonny Gaol
locations.summary: Bonny Gaol Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon in Scadu Altus.
overview: A gaol to the southeast of Bonny Village in Scadu Altus, across a wooden bridge.

locations.name: Bonny Village
locations.summary: Bonny Village Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A scorched and ruined town on the Scadu Altus, home of the Greater Potentates. Throughout the village are the jars in which the Potentates placed bodies after dismembering them to be stored in gaols.
The nearest Site of Grace is Bonny Village, located outside of the well by which the village is reached.

locations.name: Cathedral of Manus Metyr
locations.summary: The Cathedral of Manus Metyr is a location in Shadow of the Erdtree. It is located on the Scadu Altus in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: A massive cathedral on the eastern Scadu Altus, located off an exit from the Church District Highroad.
The Cathedral of Manus Metyr is the current location of the finger-weaver and high priest Count Ymir and his companion Jolán, Swordhand of Night. Gaining their trust will unlock many secrets.

The cathedral is built above the Finger Ruins of Miyr, accessible by interacting with Count Ymir's chair while he is away. However, this can only be done after progressing in his questline and ringing the bells at the Finger Ruins of Rhia and the Finger Ruins of Dheo.
The location is also surrounded by a shallow lake populated by great dragonflies, marionette soldiers, and turtles.
In the courtyard to the west of the Cathedral, there is a cemetery with the grave of Ymir's son Yuri. The cathedral also has a Remembrance Duplication Coffin.
npcs: Metyr, Mother of Fingers (Finger Ruins of Miyr)
Swordhand of Night Anna (Finger Ruins of Miyr)

locations.name: Church of the Crusade
locations.summary: The Church of the Crusade Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A massive, blackened church on the western Scadu Altus in the Realm of Shadow. The Church of the Crusade is named for Messmer's Crusade, the fiery purge of the native Hornsent.
The altar of the church is a large, ash-filled bowl with a ghostly orange flame hovering above it. Behind that stands a decapitated statue of Queen Marika.

The Church of the Crusade is one of the two locations in which Fire Knight Queelign invades the Tarnished. Depending on whether or not he has already been fought in Belurat, Tower Settlement, the interaction can play out differently.

locations.name: Darklight Catacombs
locations.summary: Darklight Catacombs Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A secluded, treacherous tomb at the end of the Recluse's River on the Scadu Altus, after traveling downstream from a coffin in Shadow Keep. The catacombs are directly south of the Recluse's River Downstream Site of Grace.

Like the other catacombs in the Realm of Shadow, these pose unique threats with phenomena not seen in the Lands Between. Unlike its counterparts, however, one will not find the typical Death Knight at the end of the dungeon. At the end of the catacombs is the Forsaken Graveyard, where the hornsent Elder Inquisitor Jori stands guard over the entrance to the Abyssal Woods, a dark and forbidden forest in the depths of the Realm of Shadow.
The Darklight Catacombs are the only way to reach the Abyssal Woods. Jori must be defeated to access the next area.

locations.name: Eastern Nameless Mausoleum
locations.summary: The Eastern Nameless Mausoleum Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A mausoleum found deep in the canyon carved by the Recluses' River on the Scadu Altus. Encountered inside is Rakshasa, a bloodthirsty warrior who lusts for carnage and wishes only to "cut down and devour" without rest.
The four nameless mausoleums in the Realm of Shadow are home to the spirits of warriors who have lost either their names or their hearts.

The nearest site of grace is Recluses' River Downstream. To get to the mausoleum, one must follow the trail northeast, then loop counterclockwise to pass by a group of Gravebirds. Then, a series of small drops leads down into the Recluses' River, which can be followed southeast until the mausoleum comes into view.

locations.name: Finger Ruins of Miyr

infobox.location: Below the Cathedral of Manus Metyr

locations.summary: The Finger Ruins of Miyr Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus.
overview: The third and final hallowed ruin of fingers. Only those with a fate sanctioned by the stars may ring the bell and meet the Mother. The ruins lie under the Cathedral of Manus Metyr on the eastern Scadu Altus.
[Access]

The Finger Ruins of Miyr are accessible after interacting with the throne of Count Ymir at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. This can only be done after ringing the finger bells at the Finger Ruins of Dheo and the Finger Ruins of Rhia, then speaking with Ymir and resting at a Site of Grace.
notable_loot: Remembrance of the Mother of Fingers (from Metyr)

locations.name: Fort of Reprimand
locations.summary: Fort of Reprimand Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A grim and gore-strewn fort on the southeastern Scadu Altus in the Realm of Shadow. Black Knight Edredd, a wielder of powerful abilities of the Crucible, helms the fort from its main hall.

While many Messmer Soldiers have been hung in the courtyard, the fort is now crawling with Omenkillers. Also in the courtyard, what remains of a pyre can be seen with dozens of charred bodies. In the subterranean dungeons, yet-living Messmer Soldiers can be found prowling. These chambers are also stacked high with empty black metal cages.
[Access and Sites of Grace]
The Fort of Reprimand has two points of access and two Sites of Grace. Which of these is encountered first depends on the direction from which the fortress is approached:
Behind the Fort of Reprimand can first be accessed via a spiritspring jump in the northeastern Gravesite Plain.

Alternatively, taking the highway south from Moorth leads to Moorth Highway, South just outside the fort. This is the closest point of access until making some progress in the fort and discovering Fort of Reprimand up on one of the battlements.
notable_loot: Ash of War: Aspects of the Crucible: Wings

locations.name: Moorth Ruins
locations.summary: Moorth Ruins Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A scorched and ruined town that has partially collapsed into the earth. The township is located in the center of the Scadu Altus in the Realm of Shadow, along the Moorth Highway which connects the Fort of Reprimand to Shadow Keep.

Moorth once had a linchpin stone that was said to hold the ground in place and calm earthquakes. The town crumbled and fell into the broken earth when the stone was shattered. One account said that "the moon itself had come tumbling down."
The nearest Site of Grace is Moorth Ruins, located in the northwestern end of town.
notable_loot: Shadow Sunflower x4, at the bottom of the sinkhole.
Dryleaf Arts, after besting Dryleaf Dane in his duel.
Golden Arcs, found in a partially buried chapel with Hornsent Inquisitors outside.

locations.name: Northern Nameless Mausoleum
locations.summary: The Northern Nameless Mausoleum Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A mausoleum high on a plateau in the Realm of Shadow, accessible by taking two spiritspring jumps from Rauh Base. Inside a man called Red Bear can be found. Once a Redmane, he has lost his name to madness after being tempted by the untainted glory and strength of the red spirithorned bears.
The four nameless mausoleums in the Realm of Shadow are home to the spirits of warriors who have lost either their names or their hearts.

The nearest site of grace is Temple Town Ruins. The two spiritspring jumps are located to the east of the Temple Town Ruins. The first one is sealed, with the stones locking them found just up the path.

locations.name: Rabbath's Rise
locations.summary: Rabbath's Rise Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus in Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: A towering Glintstone Rise on the northeastern Scadu Altus, due north of the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. The spire is much taller than that of any other rise seen in Elden Ring.
The rise is named after Spellmachinist Rabbath, an innovative glintstone sorcerer who developed a magic-powered cannon. Rabbath's bell bearing and cannon can both be found in the rise.
The rise can be accessed two ways:
Enabling and then using a nearby Sealed Spiritspring to jump with Torrent into the tower.
Dropping onto the rise from above, on the cliffs of the Shaman Village in Scaduview.

locations.name: Recluses' River
overview: The Recluses' River Shadow of the Erdtree is a river in the Realm of Shadow. It is not a strictly outlined region in-game, but it is a colloquially referenced sub-section of the Scadu Altus that is not accessible from anywhere else in the area. The river is physically separated from the rest of the region by its low elevation.

The river originates in the Castle Watering Hole of Shadow Keep where the Ruins of Unte are found. A series of waterfalls then passes by the Village of Flies and the Eastern Nameless Mausoleum, running under Bonny Village and finally emptying into the Abyssal Woods.

To access the Recluses' River, one must enter a hidden room behind one of the waterfalls at the shipyard in Shadow Keep. Behind an illusory wall, there is a stone coffin that, when entered, flows down the stream into the Castle Watering Hole.
The Recluses' River is also the only way via which the Abyssal Woods can be accessed; near the terminal waterfall, the Darklight Catacombs can be found to provide a path into the forbidden forest.

There are three Sites of Grace located along the Recluses' River: Castle Watering Hole, Recluses' River Upstream, and Recluses' River Downstream. The latter two are found on a rocky, precipitous trail that follows the river's path south.
notes: The namesake of the river is left up to interpretation. The eponymous recluses may be the Man-Flies that live in the canyon or another unknown party.

locations.name: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past
locations.summary: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past Shadow of the Erdtree is a dungeon on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A run-down forge on the southern Scadu Altus, strewn with smoldering and ruined weaponry. The entrance is located southwest of Moorth, found by following the Moorth Highway south and then turning to the west. It is also visible from the balcony in the Castle-Lord's Chamber at Castle Ensis.

The plain around the forge is littered with massive ruined columns. Like the other Ruined Forges in the Realm of Shadow, the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past does not have a boss encounter; to find the ultimate prize of the dungeon requires a little more care. This forge contains the Ancient Meteoric Ore Greatsword, a powerful and massive blade fashioned from an arrowhead of the old gods.
In ancient times, the smithing that occurred here was a divine act; even the anvil was an altar. Though those times are past, Golem Smiths remain active and lava remains a threat.
The Ruined Forge of Starfall Past is a suitable place to harvest Gas Stones. They were likely used as fuel for the forges at one point, but they are now used to craft the Hefty Volcano Pot.

locations.name: Ruins of Unte
locations.summary: Ruins of Unte Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A scorched and ruined Hornsent township in the watering hole of Shadow Keep. The area around the town is littered with the wreckages of Furnace Golems from Messmer's Crusade, though one still functions.

Much of the town is flooded and destroyed, but the keep within is relatively intact. The central building has a chest containing Giant Golden Arc, an incantation used by the Hornsent Inquisitors. The inner courtyard of the town is initially blocked by a wrecked Furnace Golem, which must be restarted by throwing a Hefty Furnace Pot at it from one of the buildings sticking out of the water. When reactivated, the golem will begin attacking; it must then either be avoided or defeated to enter the central area.
Unte also contains one of the three Altars of Light and Darkness.

The nearest Sites of Grace are Castle Watering Hole and Recluses' River Upstream, found to the west and south of town respectively. The castle watering hole will naturally be encountered first as it is the only point of access to Unte and the rest of the Recluses' River.
notable_loot: Oil-Soaked Tear, taken from the Furnace Golem outside the town.
Bloodsucking Cracked Tear, taken from the Furnace Golem at the town's gate.

locations.name: Village of Flies
locations.summary: Village of Flies Shadow of the Erdtree is a location on the Scadu Altus.
overview: A settlement of Man-Flies found along the Recluses' River on the Scadu Altus. While there are no actual buildings in the village, there are assorted Hornsent artifacts and Man-Fly exoskeletons. Accompanying them are shadow undead healers capable of producing swarms of flies, though they never become infected themselves.
The exoskeletons are the byproduct of a metamorphosis that was believed to be the end of the Man-Flies' suffering.
The nearest Sites of Grace is Recluses' River Downstream.

locations.name: Whipping Hut
locations.summary: The Whipping Hut is a location on the Scadu Altus in the Realm of Shadow.
overview: A burnt, ruined shack in the outskirts of Bonny Village. Not much remains besides the frames and part of the wall. It is located on a mesa carved by the Recluses' River, separated from both the village and the rest of the plateau by rope bridges.

In the Whipping Hut, the Hornsent of Bonny Village flagellated shamans with tooth-bestrewn whips. The wounds from these lashings grew inflamed and oozed pus. As indicated by the Stranded Soul at the hut, the shamans would also be stuffed into jars to achieve "nigh-sainthood". It was the belief of the Stranded Soul that this was the sole purpose of the shamans' existence and the only reason for which they were accorded life.
The closest Sites of Grace are Bonny Village and Bridge Leading to the Village, located to the hut's west and east respectively.

locations.name: Albinauric's Shack
locations.summary: Albinauric's Shack is a location in Elden Ring.
overview: A small shack north-west of the battlefield where Commander Gaius resides in Scaduview. An Albinauric archer is nearby seemingly defending the structure, the Albinauric archers were in a class of their own, and their deadly long-range specialists struck fear into the hearts of men. Commander Gaius was an Albinauric as well, and black iron grieves were made for him as a cruel joke. Riding atop the boar he called his other half, Commander Gaius was the leader of Messmer's army. Both he and Messmer were as elder brothers to the lion, and both were cursed from birth. Gaius was cursed because Albinaurics are lifeforms made by human hands. Thus, many believe them to live impure lives, untouched by the Erdtree's grace. Gaius's armor is patterned after fallen seeds.

locations.name: Finger Ruins of Dheo
locations.summary: The Finger Ruins of Dheo Shadow of the Erdtree is a location in Scaduview in Shadow of the Erdtree.
overview: A hallowed ruin of fingers, the second of three encountered in Count Ymir's questline. Only those with a fate sanctioned by the stars may ring the bell at the center, which advances the questline and grants the Cerulean Seed Talisman +1.
The mysterious ruins consist of a vast stone plain with a fingerprint-like topography. Massive finger-shaped obelisks point inwards toward the hanging bell.
The nearest Site of Grace is Fingerstone Hill, found just north of the ruins.
[Access]
The Finger Ruins of Dheo can be found by following the road southeast from the Hinterland Bridge.

locations.name: Scadutree Chalice
locations.summary: The Scadutree Chalice is a landmark in Scaduview in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC.
overview: The Scadutree Chalice lies not too far from the Scadutree. It is said that when the Scadutree crumbles from its core that it will scatter across the entire realm of shadow. The people of the Erdtree collect the splintered fragments and use them in prayer. Shards of bone with a golden shine can also be found here. They are bone fragments touched by the gold of the Scadutree, broken from the remains of the warriors who perished in the realm of shadow. A blessing such as this is said to be the greatest honor that can be granted to the dead.

locations.name: Shaman Village
locations.summary: The Shaman Village (巫子の村) is a location in Scaduview in the Shadow of the Erdtree DLC.
overview: The Shaman Village is a peaceful area guarded by two Tree Sentinels in the Hinterland. This village was the home of Queen Marika who bathed it only in the kindness of gold without Order from a small, illusory Erdtree, knowing full well that there was no one left to heal. Queen Marika offered a braid of her golden hair, cut loose, to the Grandmother of the village. What was her prayer? Her wish, her confession? There is no one left to answer, and Marika never returned home again. The shaman apart from Marika had been spirited away by the hornsent, and used in jarring rituals. This is because the flesh of shamans was said to meld harmoniously with others. The actions of the hornsent would explain the dark notions that bear no sense of Order which Marika used to create the Scadutree, and the cleansing crusade that she would have her son lead against them.

locations.name: Scadutree Base
locations.summary: Scadutree Base Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region of the Shadow Keep.
overview: Deep below the Shadow Keep past the Tree-Worship passage and Tree-Worship Sanctum lies the Scadutree Base, which is the closest point to the Scadutree itself. Shadow Sunflowers face the Scadutree, these flowers, veiled in shadow and covered in impenetrable thorns, are suffused with profound holiness—much like the Scadutree. The Scadutree is the shadow of the Erdtree. Born of dark notions that bear no sense of Order, that twist and bend its stock, rendering it brittle. The Scadutree bears a second stalk winding tightly around the first, almost as if in a tender embrace.

locations.name: Scaduview
locations.summary: Scaduview Shadow of the Erdtree is a sub-region of the Shadow Keep region.
overview: A rugged highland in the embrace of the Scadutree, just outside the back gate of Shadow Keep. The sub-region encompasses the Hinterland, the area surrounding the Scadutree Chalice, and the Finger Ruins of Dheo. Scaduview is the northernmost area in the Realm of Shadow, and the homeland of Queen Marika the Eternal.
[Hinterland]

Far above the Tree-Worship Sanctum at the Scadutree base, tranquil fields of flowers line the road leading up to the Shaman Village, Marika's home town. The Shaman Village sits atop steep cliffs overlooking the Church District Highroad on the Scadu Altus.
The Hinterland is guarded by a duo of Tree Sentinels carrying the Blessing of Marika. The Hinterland Bridge connects the area to Fingerstone Hill.
